**🔴 I told you:** Dark money groups have now poured in over $2.6 MILLION to boost my opponents.
**🔴 I told you:** One of my opponents has been hammering the airwaves with ads for WEEKS, and another is going live imminently.
**🔴 And now, I'm telling you: **My first TV ad JUST went live, and**** if I can't raise another $250,000 today to help close the gap, we won't be able to keep our new ad on air for long.
#### **[Please, don't make me beg. I hate asking you for money, but I refuse to take a CENT of corporate PAC money. I just need 3 more local Democrats to step up today. Can I count on you to chip in $5 to help close the gap? >>](https://substack.com/redirect/9376ac4f-410f-4621-a6ad-5a06338ea000?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Here's the honest truth.
In 2024, I ran for Congress in Maryland, and I fought as hard as I possibly could.
But dark money groups spent **MILLIONS** of dollars to drown me out, and it worked.
I watched it happen in real time: ads I couldn't match, mailers I couldn't answer, and a wall of money between me and the voters I was trying to reach.
When you have the kind of money my opponents do, you don't have to win the argument. **You just have to make sure the other side can 't be heard.**
That's why it's so incredibly important to fund this latest ad buy so that I can fight back and show my opponents that our grassroots momentum is nothing to laugh at.
I know that I can win this race. But I can't win it if I can't keep my ads on air and show every single voter in Maryland's 5th Congressional District why they need to send me to Congress.

name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: A long email but one worth reading
body:
Starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
| | | |
---
Peter,
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. **[If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11936?amount=5&t=8&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)**
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for more than 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight – or sometimes even large – lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on election night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead – which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
Experts are calling this race a “Toss Up.” Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran, recent polling shows me statistically tied with his handpicked candidate. Even the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes – just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 – in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency – only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
[**Please, Peter: Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11936?amount=5&t=9&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11937?amount=5&t=10&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
---

---
| | [DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11938?t=13&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
---
Thank you for reading. I appreciate it.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8188?t=2&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

name: Elise Stefanik
subject: I’ll come right out and say it…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Team Elise, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of E-PAC and Save New York
body:
Our efforts are falling short.
| Peter,
---
The latest polling is setting off alarm bells in GOP headquarters – _and for good reason_!
---
**_Democrats hold 6-point advantage in battleground districts: Poll_**
[Source: _The Hill_]
---
You read that right: Democrats now **LEAD** by **_6 POINTS_** on the generic ballot in battleground districts with only a few months to go until the midterm elections begin!
---
**I’ve always been honest with you, so I’ll come right out and say it: Our voter verification efforts are falling short.__IF__ this polling holds, President Trump’s Majority is as good as __GONE__. **
---
Far Left Democrats will seize power in the people’s House and take control of committee gavels, the power of the purse, impeachment powers, and they’ll use it all to go after the President and his supporters.
---
Remember, they were willing to throw President Trump in JAIL as an innocent man just to win an election. __These radicals will stop at NOTHING to DESTROY MAGA!__
---
But there’s one MAJOR silver lining...
---
**We still have enough time to close this 6-point gap by verifying thousands of reliable Republican voters who are still marked as “UNVERIFIED” in our system.**
---
At the end of the day, the GOP has the numbers advantage: If all of our voters turn out and cast a ballot, we WILL defy history and win the midterms!
---

August 8, 2009, is a date I will never forget.
Just days before his 19th birthday, my son Justin was out in the fields with us, doing what this family has done for over three generations—farming the Louisiana delta. A breakdown in our combine left corn spilled across the ground, and as we worked to recover it, Justin got too close. In an instant, his pant leg was caught, and the thresher pulled him in.
I can still hear his voice: “Dad, get me out.”
And there was nothing I could do.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Multiple miracles occurred that day: When it initially happened he wasn’t in pain because his nerves were pinched so tightly in the machine. Nor was he bleeding because he was caught so tight in there.
It took the jaws of life to tear apart that machine and when the metal finally gave way he let out a scream that I will never forget for the rest of my life.
The paramedics quickly sprang into action and he was airlifted to Jackson, Mississippi, where Doctors fought to save his leg, but the injury and infection from all the dirt and debris were too severe. Justin lost his leg from below the knee.
That day could have broken us. Instead, it showed me what makes Louisiana strong.
Neighbors, first responders from two parishes (what we call counties in Louisiana), and a doctor who wasn’t even on duty, Dr. Ron Gregg, a farmer himself and longtime family friend — showed up because that’s what rural communities do. They take care of each other. They don’t ask if it’s their job or jurisdiction. They just show up.
Today, Justin is 35. He runs our farm. He’s built a life, with a fiancée and a family of his own. He still hunts, fishes, and works the land — just with a prosthetic leg and the same determination that carried him through that day.
But the truth is, the kind of community that saved Justin is disappearing. Rural hospitals are closing. Doctors like Dr. Gregg—who live in our communities, who know our families—are harder to find. Too many of our kids feel like they have to leave home to build a future.
And my family, who first worked this Louisiana delta soil as slaves and sharecroppers, and now as farmers who own this land, have put too much blood into this soil for us to leave and go somewhere else.
I have to take a stand and fight for our way of life and it’s why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana.
If you believe in that fight, I’m asking you to stand with me today. A Democratic win here is the first step in taking our state back from the far-right whose policies of atomization and vicious corporatism are tearing our communities apart.
And mark my words, a win is possible, Democrats just won a deep red special election here by a landslide. The blue wave will wash over Louisiana and we will flip this seat but only if we fight for it. Will you please make a contribution of $50, $20, or even just $10 to help us in our fight to restore the Louisiana that we love so dearly. The American people have completely lost faith in our federal government, and honestly, can you blame them? Washington has turned into a playground for the wealthy and well-connected. Members of Congress spend half their days fundraising from elite corporate donors and the other half trading stocks based on confidential committee information.
My name is Mike Cortese. I am running for Congress in TN-04 and my diagnosis is simple: the system is fundamentally broken, and it's because career politicians have zero incentive to fix a system that**makes them rich.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/566aea6e-75f4-4e4c-b5c4-bbb47bbd118f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Help us clean up Washington.[Chip in $25 today to fund our fight for true government accountability.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7809b4de-a57a-44ad-9141-e0adad582575?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[It all starts HERE! Join Today!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7809b4de-a57a-44ad-9141-e0adad582575?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I believe public service is a temporary sacrifice, not a lifetime career. On the Metro Council, transparency and strict ethical adherence aren't optional, they are expected. **We need to bring that exact same standard to the federal government.**
When I am elected to represent the 4th District, I will fight for structural reforms: banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks, overturning _Citizens United_ to get dark money out of our politics, and implementing strict ethics rules for representatives and lobbyists alike.
If we want to change Washington, we have to change the types of people we send there. I am running a transparent, people-powered campaign. subject: An insider NM poll just landed
body:
Plus: Trump's approval just hit a number no president has held in 17 years. | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ZmaWSH1bXLC?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
An insider poll just landed on our desk. It covered the biggest races in New Mexico. The results aren't what people expect.
[We had the pollster on to break it all down — and tell us who actually wins.](https://us.list-manage.com/16HwgmWQK97?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ROEdmHJhwOv?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **INSIDER POLL: GREGG HULL 33, DOUG TURNER 30, DUKE RODRIGUEZ 12 — 25% UNDECIDED**
Nicole McCleskey of Public Opinion Strategies — the pollster behind Susana Martinez and 13 gubernatorial races in 2022 — joined us with her husband Jay, one of New Mexico's top GOP strategists, to break down the numbers on Gregg Hull, Doug Turner, and Duke Rodriguez.
The horse race number tells one story. The favorability numbers tell a completely different one. And there's a specific stat about Duke that tells you why he can't win this race no matter what he does from here.
Then she made her call. Jay did too. One person at our table didn't agree — and you'll never guess who.

🚨 **HULL'S CAMPAIGN HAS A PROBLEM. SO DOES TURNER.**
Turner is attacking. Hull is not responding. That math doesn't end well in any campaign we've ever seen.
The regional breakdown is even more revealing. There's one part of New Mexico where Turner is up 30 points on Hull. There's another part where Hull is up 27. We show you the map.
If Hull doesn't change something fast, the pollster says this could be a 20-point race. The wrong direction.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/4FiTVRfvFqO?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
📉 **TRUMP'S APPROVAL JUST HIT A NUMBER NO PRESIDENT HAS SEEN IN 17 YEARS**
37%. The NYT/Siena poll just dropped, and it's the lowest second-term number in nearly two decades. Underwater on immigration — his strongest issue a year ago. Underwater on cost of living. Underwater everywhere.
What that means for whoever wins the Republican primary in New Mexico is the conversation every campaign in the country is having right now. We had it on the show.

⛽ **DEB HAALAND TRIED TO ANSWER A FRACKING QUESTION. IT DIDN'T GO WELL.**
KRQE's Jessica Garate asked a yes-or-no question. The former Interior Secretary couldn't get there. Then Jessica asked a follow-up.
When you see what banning fracking on public lands actually means for New Mexico schools, you'll understand why she didn't want to answer the first time.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/18uGDH9x8zx?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
PLUS: Trump just endorsed Ken Paxton in Texas — but the Democrat, James Talarico, is polling at 44%. The best number a Texas Democrat has hit for Senate since 2002. We break down what that does to the Republican Senate map.

Friend, we're down to the wire. Before I ask you to **_[make an urgent donation to help my campaign in the last 7 days,](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8175?refcode=jtk793-fr-nd&t=2&akid=9885%2E400544%2EhLUDjr)_** I'd like to share how I got here and what I am fighting for.
I am the proud descendant of generations of fierce Pueblo women. Their strength and resilience gave me the courage to run for office and fight for New Mexicans, including standing up to Donald Trump.
**I made history as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And _when_ we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. **
**But for me, this work has never been about titles or being the first.**
It’s about fighting for working families, standing up for New Mexicans, and making sure more people have a seat at the table. I want to leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders and build a government that truly reflects and fights for the people it serves. Higher wages. Lower costs. Stronger education so our kids can read earlier. Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico so you can see a doctor even when you’re not sick. Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatments and rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can make our communities safer.
__**That's just a quick look into my vision for the future of New Mexico and our country, and now, I'm asking you to invest in it. I truly believe there's nothing we can't accomplish if we work together, and with thousands of New Mexicans already casting their ballots, I need you with me now more than ever._[So please, friend, can I count on you to chip in $5 or more before the June 2 primary to help me fight for working families, deliver real progress for New Mexicans, and leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8175?refcode=jtk793-fr-nd&t=3&akid=9885%2E400544%2EhLUDjr)_**

clean_body: | | | | Friend, we're down to the wire. Before I ask you to I'd like to share how I got here and what I am fighting for. I am the proud descendant of generations of fierce Pueblo women. Their strength and resilience gave me the courage to run for office and fight for New Mexicans, including standing up to Donald Trump. I made history as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And when we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. But for me, this work has never been about titles or being the first. It’s about fighting for working families, standing up for New Mexicans, and making sure more people have a seat at the table. I want to leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders and build a government that truly reflects and fights for the people it serves. Higher wages. Lower costs. Stronger education so our kids can read earlier. Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico so you can see a doctor even when you’re not sick. Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatments and rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can make our communities safer. That's just a quick look into my vision for the future of New Mexico and our country, and now, I'm asking you to invest in it. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-footer?refcode=header&amount=5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-footer?refcode=header&amount=5]
Dear friends,
I recently had the pleasure of hosting an Instagram Live chat [https://www.instagram.com/reels/DYn1f9OiYIC/] with my good friend and South Asian community leader Harini Krishnan to celebrate Asian American, Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander Heritage Month. She shared that, to her, this month celebrates the AANHPI pioneers that have shaped US history.
I totally agree – and the pioneers that came to mind were my grandparents.
All four of them – Alfonso and Vivencia Vanderlipe & Quintin and Fausta Ramil – immigrated from the Philippines (each with seven kids in tow!) to give their family the opportunity to dream big
As they raised children in a world and language they didn’t know, cleaned hospitals and served as cooks, they also built community – not just to maintain the traditions of home, but to fight and organize against injustice together.
Today, because of their sacrifices, I now have the honor of serving as the first Filipino, and the first AANHPI woman, to lead the California Democratic Party as Executive Director.
And I could not be prouder that, in this role, I get to carry on their legacy.
That’s not something I take lightly. Growing up, I never saw people who looked like us in positions of political leadership or power.
And now, every single day, I get to help lead the largest state Democratic Party in the country at one of the most important moments in our nation’s history.
I’ve had the privilege of helping elect Democrats up and down the ballot, serving as California Deputy State Director on the Harris-Walz campaign, working for Senator Kamala Harris, and helping build a strong bench of Democratic women leaders as Executive Director of Emerge California.
At every step, I’ve seen firsthand what organizing as a unified community can accomplish. In fact, it’s exactly what my grandparents set out to do as they founded Filipino American organizations in the Bay Area in the 1960s.
I’ve seen volunteers turn hopeless races into victories. I’ve seen intersectional communities come together to protect fundamental rights and freedoms. And I’ve seen people step up in extraordinary moments because they believed our democracy – our humanity – was worth fighting for.
This spirit is what inspires me at CADEM today. Especially in the hard moments.
We simply cannot afford to let Trump and Republicans take that away – there is too much at stake for our communities.
California has always led the way forward. Not because change happens on its own, but because California Democrats organize for it. We fight for it. We believe in something bigger than ourselves, just like our grandparents and ancestors have done for generations before us.
That’s why I’m proud to be a California Democrat. And it’s why I’m so grateful to be in this fight alongside you – like me, I know you’re also bringing with you the spark that those before you ignited within you.
If you’re able to, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution to support the California Democratic Party’s work across the state — in the name of hope, justice, and humanity. No pressure, I mostly just wanted to tell you a little bit more about myself, who inspires me, and thank you for being part of this movement. CHIP IN $ >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-may26?&refcode=&amount=]Thank you again for being here and listening to a piece of my family’s story. It truly means a lot.
Salamat Po,
Melanie V. Ramil
Executive Director
California Democratic Party &
Proud Granddaughter of Alfonso and Vivencia Vanderlipe & Quintin and Fausta Ramil

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
Friends, the White House’s latest political stunt was built around one of the GOP’s favorite buzzwords: fraud.
Today, Vice President JD Vance held a roundtable on fraud with a group of Republican state attorneys general.
He invited those Republican AGs more than a week ago — but Democratic AGs didn’t get the same treatment. Instead, we got a disingenuous, last-minute invitation late Friday afternoon.
No Democratic AG attended — because we won’t be used as props in Vance’s political performance.
(And if there was any doubt this wasn’t a good-faith effort, consider this: the head of my office's Medicaid Fraud Control Unit went to DC and showed up at the roundtable despite the late notice — and was actually turned away at the door.)
No matter what Trump and Vance want people to think, this just isn’t a partisan issue.
Fraud affects every state and every community. I’m proud that Democratic AGs are going after it with the full force of our offices, recovering billions in taxpayer dollars, securing convictions, and implementing reforms to strengthen our programs — because we don't need a White House invitation to do our jobs.
Here are just a few highlights of my office’s longstanding work to eradicate fraud:
California DOJ’s Division of Medi-Cal Fraud and Elder Abuse is on the ground every day, investigating and prosecuting fraudsters who steal from patients, seniors, and taxpayers. Just last month, we dismantled a massive hospice fraud operation in Los Angeles County that defrauded Medi-Cal of $267 million — the largest hospice fraud bust in state history.
In the last 10 years, we’ve conducted more than 2,300 criminal investigations related to fraud, filed charges against 958 individuals, and recovered more than $2.8 billion in state funds.
That's what real fraud enforcement looks like.
The reality is, fraudsters and scam artists operate in every state in the country — looking to make an easy buck off taxpayers’ backs. But instead of working with us to root out fraud and protect taxpayers, Trump and Vance have decided to gaslight the American people and exploit the issue to score political points.
No matter what partisan games the White House plays, I will never back down from holding anyone who targets our state systems accountable to the fullest extent of the law.
If you want to support our efforts to wipe out fraud and waste across California, will you make a contribution today to help power this work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

DONATE $500 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?express_lane=true&amount=500] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
With your help, we’ll keep doing this important work to tackle fraud the same way we always have: heads down, sleeves rolled up, and laser-focused on delivering results.
And if the federal government ever decides to quit playing games, we’ll be here — ready and willing to join forces to tackle fraud.
Thank you for your support.
—Rob

# [Legislative Comparison](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/05/26/legislative-comparison/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on May 26, 2026
---
| Many voters might wonder how my votes would compare to those of Representative Joyce.

Every week I send out a newsletter and if you scroll to the bottom, you will see this legislative comparison.

In it, you will find the columns that include name of the bills, how Joyce voted, if the bill passed the U.S. House of Representatives or not, how I would have voted, and my brief rationale for my vote on that bill. I have linked the bills to their actual text for your convenience.

FYI – if you’re having trouble seeing this comparison in your email, please click the option for “Read on Blog” and it will load properly for you.
---

Peter,
He called organizations like ours "leftist terror cells." Now Ken Paxton is one step closer to the U.S. Senate.
Tonight, Ken Paxton defeated John Cornyn in the Republican runoff. Let that sink in. The man who directed his office to “identify, investigate, and infiltrate” progressive organizations operating in Texas is now the Republican nominee for United States Senate.
He wasn’t talking about someone else. He was talking about us.
YES, I'll give monthly to fight back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&recurring=1]
This is not a drill. 🚨
“When Paxton ordered undercover investigations into organizations like TOP, he wasn’t just playing politics,” said Brianna Brown, Executive Director of the Texas Organizing Project. “He was sending a signal to every Black and Latino family in this state: you don’t belong here, and we will come for you if you organize. We’ve been called worse by people with less power. And we are still here. But make no mistake: this moment demands everything we have. A Paxton Senate seat is a direct threat to voting rights, immigrant communities, reproductive freedom, and the organizing infrastructure we've spent years building. We cannot sleepwalk into November.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&refcode2=5648e92e-7859-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&refcode2=5648e92e-7859-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c]
We have been here before. Targeted. Surveilled. Underestimated.
We are still organizing, still turning out the voters the political establishment writes off.
Still building the multi-racial, community power that keeps people like Paxton up at night. That’s exactly why he’s coming for us.
Will you rush a contribution to help us fight back at the ballot box this midterm?
I'll make a one-time gift right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00]
He picked this fight. We intend to finish it.
If you can, set up a monthly gift today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&recurring=1] and make your support automatic. We need to know we can count on you through November.

body:
This is it. The final stretch is officially here.

| |
---
| | Peter, seven days. One week until CA-40 decides whether we move forward with courage and new leadership, or stay stuck with the same MAGA politicians who’ve spent years failing working families. This campaign has already blown me away. We started with no political machine. No billionaire backing. No built-in advantage.
Now we’re seven days away from pulling off something people said was impossible. [**If you can chip in $5 to help us power through this final week, I’d be incredibly grateful.**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jKqGwPsQmV4BdlOIptvezg~~/AAUS1hA~/OlDEJ6n0Q2W0UQORgYz9KDNCcMtkG4Xc4T6i7_qg1gvKeN4gvLLlKNSHVjN1WjoQ-RzTCaDW29ku9viy0KRZdSz3KogVpyLw7TVLbqhwkf-AKS_RRAsQ3DG8CrP4ro6mHuvTI778t79an9B3BEyyXF96BD324JvJqktT4CAPvjcAJIIkNyWeBU4piUpcnIkTA5AuP9E5Y86BlQLtt9k6lsBj7ARMCMk0HV0wGh41bUw~) | | [PRESS TO DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jKqGwPsQmV4BdlOIptvezg~~/AAUS1hA~/OlDEJ6n0Q2W0UQORgYz9KDNCcMtkG4Xc4T6i7_qg1gvKeN4gvLLlKNSHVjN1WjoQ-RzTCaDW29ku9viy0KRZdSz3KogVpyLw7TVLbqhwkf-AKS_RRAsQ3DG8CrP4ro6mHuvTI778t79an9B3BEyyXF96BD324JvJqktT4CAPvjcAJIIkNyWeBU4piUpcnIkTA5AuP9E5Y86BlQLtt9k6lsBj7ARMCMk0HV0wGh41bUw~)
---
These next seven days are going to be intense.
1. More TV ads.
2. More attacks.
3. More mailers.
4. More noise.

But we have something stronger: people.

body:
I’m honored
| It’s official, family.

**I’m proud to stand before you as your Democratic nominee in the U.S Senate race for Kentucky.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109919?t=6&akid=24505%2E878179%2EResqMw) First, I cannot thank you enough for putting your trust and faith in our movement. I know you’re tired. I know you’re sick of politicians ignoring our communities.

**This is a declaration of regular people from forgotten places who feel like the government has turned away from them.** Because the people of Kentucky have spoken, and I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and fight harder than ever for the future of our Commonwealth.

I’m fighting for livable wages, Medicare for All, affordable housing, a Working People's Bill of Rights, and ending forever wars.

I’m fighting for my daughters’ future, our children, and YOU.

**Now, we’re racing toward the general election. That means our work to flip this seat starts _now._ We’re going to run away with it, but only if we do it together.**

[Opportunities like this don't come around often, which is why I’m asking you to split a $10 gift between me and the Voter Protection Project to fuel this general election fight to flip Kentucky’s open Senate seat blue.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109919?t=7&akid=24505%2E878179%2EResqMw) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Charles Booker and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109920?t=8&akid=24505%2E878179%2EResqMw)

Hello Friend, In a world filled with noise, confusion, and constant pressure, many people are searching for something that feels increasingly rare. A sense of peace that actually lasts. If you have ever wondered what the Bible really says about living a meaningful and fulfilled life, you are not alone. One of the most powerful teachings of Jesus is called the Beatitudes. If you have never heard that term before, you are not alone there either.

| | The Beatitudes are a short collection of statements Jesus made about what it truly means to be "blessed." But His definition may surprise you. He said those who are humble, those who show mercy, even those who are struggling can experience a kind of life that is deeply meaningful and secure. That is very different from what most of us have been taught.

| Friend,
$1.6 billion.
The single largest political contribution in American history. Every penny was secured by one man and directed towards an insidious plot to pack our courts with right-wing extremists. A plan so methodical and calculated, that it unraveled over the course of 30 years in complete darkness. The architect of this coup is named Leonard Leo and if you've never heard of him, that is exactly how he wants it.
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001N6N4epTOx6cuM6XnaUmKtEa7zHVNs-lnl9tRTGVOpXfytlb1oOVc3hUKlhBtBjmkuArMQ2xuKSEJXby4NmvrCcEe5wvWkgiXE-FskwrX7gAIzU4EWdCs2b4oOdd2IoV94TIE2eoWj5nRXnSjp7y9pm59Hr_ECaXuV-TgGIgQkkOFtCtMeA-m-rb7efiCX31Ap8xb4DL9w9AWp_q3_fIkZNfZcom8o_j0DgzjpdotqgKSsGFNX9ufuZbKvQA2UOv5mvfwM2mqr2I=&c=AQJ_iaTgEN1sRMP8_OcuUibvdY9apUMoAoajgOG9pl7OAG9YGofHcA==&ch=gGPuBfrAMjhxLRL2Qg3xK-zjw99hV93foSleazRgQKWwApcOK5YgNw==)
---
| Who is Leonard Leo?
He has never appeared on a ballot. He does not seek the spotlight. He is the Chairman of the Federalist Society and operates in the shadows. And from those shadows he has done incomprehensible damage to American democracy.
Leonard Leo built the Supreme Court's extremist conservative majority. He placed Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Barrett on the court. And when Trump gets to replace two or three of the oldest justices, which he is already preparing to do, Leonard Leo will choose their replacements.
Here is what Leo's court has already delivered: Roe overturned. Trump granted criminal immunity. Citizens United enabled. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Federal regulatory power dismantled. That is not a full list. It is barely the beginning. Leonard Leo is the reason you are angry. He's the reason for our polarized politics, the corruption with no accountability, the rights that have been stripped away, the dysfunction that feels permanent. He did not cause all of it. But he built the judicial infrastructure that made all of it possible, and that is making all of it permanent.
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001N6N4epTOx6cuM6XnaUmKtEa7zHVNs-lnl9tRTGVOpXfytlb1oOVc3hUKlhBtBjmkuArMQ2xuKSEJXby4NmvrCcEe5wvWkgiXE-FskwrX7gAIzU4EWdCs2b4oOdd2IoV94TIE2eoWj5nRXnSjp7y9pm59Hr_ECaXuV-TgGIgQkkOFtCtMeA-m-rb7efiCX31Ap8xb4DL9w9AWp_q3_fIkZNfZcom8o_j0DgzjpdotqgKSsGFNX9ufuc9R3rfAi3D2WLss1DRSo58=&c=AQJ_iaTgEN1sRMP8_OcuUibvdY9apUMoAoajgOG9pl7OAG9YGofHcA==&ch=gGPuBfrAMjhxLRL2Qg3xK-zjw99hV93foSleazRgQKWwApcOK5YgNw==)
---
| And then he came for the states.
Leo spent a decade doing to state Supreme Courts exactly what he did to SCOTUS, because state courts decide voting rights, reproductive freedom, and the maps that determine who controls Congress. We were watching. We beat his machine in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Both times he came with his network and his money. Both times we beat him.
The state court firewall is essential. But it is not enough while Leo's Supreme Court keeps changing the rules. The only permanent answer is to unpack the court he built, and the Constitution gives us that power. Congress has changed the number of justices seven times. No amendment required.
Leo has a thirty year head start, billions in dark money cash, and a Supreme Court that has already chosen his side. But we have hundreds of thousands of Democrats who have pitched in to defeat him twice. We like our odds. But we need you with us for what comes next: the Kansas ballot initiative, November Supreme Court elections, the 2026 midterms, and the sustained campaign to reform the court that made all of this possible. [Can we count on you to rush a donation of $50, $25, or whatever you can spare to take on Leonard Leo at the state and federal levels, simultaneously, until we win?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001N6N4epTOx6cuM6XnaUmKtEa7zHVNs-lnl9tRTGVOpXfytlb1oOVc3hUKlhBtBjmkuArMQ2xuKSEJXby4NmvrCcEe5wvWkgiXE-FskwrX7gAIzU4EWdCs2b4oOdd2IoV94TIE2eoWj5nRXnSjp7y9pm59Hr_ECaXuV-TgGIgQkkOFtCtMeA-m-rb7efiCX31Ap8xb4DL9w9AWp_q3_fIkZNfZcom8o_j0DgzjpdotqgKSsGFNX9ufuZViHuXlWhiuCnztLNO209Q=&c=AQJ_iaTgEN1sRMP8_OcuUibvdY9apUMoAoajgOG9pl7OAG9YGofHcA==&ch=gGPuBfrAMjhxLRL2Qg3xK-zjw99hV93foSleazRgQKWwApcOK5YgNw==)

## Iran Threatens US Over New Strikes
U.S. forces [carried out strikes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSpCAQhJ9GMywW0dGA4BKzvfRCi4XRnTuELZhdzrf_y_8V_rS7uqu__nNf75YCxf23PdDwltaItQRkxrxStrFUmyPF_WX_c4qVYrHRr0qqUchBKFi9pXCuuvVmQ1TYt2huAPMEowZon0ah1PM4PObRawVyUtpCP_hJAXjda9eSudrkoOAmJQxD5-Wop0FqcM5OEm6NluiJU-7-Jor8xC2c6YO5c-log3kyv0rT_2rU0qil1trFh7soLv9SUg6-UctF06jlXcRBgdjmUxR7FuFS9G_H6EXBsAmPG8aConCmf1gE27wjF3HFRXbR9nqc-rnNxr8qhUBlhEbL_bAUvhfxj278GPUVAAD__7COiDo) in southern Iran on Monday, hitting missile launch sites and Iranian boats accused of laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran called the strikes a clear violation of the seven-week ceasefire and threatened retaliation. Iran's Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, said American military bases in the Middle East are [no longer safe](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAURb8Gd4wwBp63oEjjbtOmtJ7N8_glGCxgx_HfR5Nf2PpK9-icX5_zJ3Lk9PyJB_m25TnRVSO1RmXmgqleWBKn54l_W04Xp4opzFppJ5WVGuaAHO_ZdMFvRJqGjnwP8DGCMwDd7gEWADWsGvU20GIGdMvQrwMGhW61rmP_flNWQ68UWPsIypnRKgPriqOCXhhFgVsuj9-ZU9tpi3d-UXms-eii31s7qxh-CD0JPbWddo7xvQk9nTnyegs9cWpUEjbOCaPQkx0_jDNWvhVl_ToLHSQjYaAiv6o8OHLDcssFK8naCv-hKvTUFR_Oi2Pk6kAY9TyQ_7O69q14L6__BQAA___x0YTA), in a message marking the start of the Hajj, the annual Muslim pilgrimage to Mecca. Despite the tensions, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said it could take "a few more days" to [finalize a deal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAURb9GOwwyIFpQvMZuXvtKg3AYzxtEw2GGO39_4_2F261kJyt773_35W4xYnr8tTuYEo4lQaUIpUBeMNtE1eaE6XHar3Kkiols8ovgYmBcMaEXbzF-Ftl6EwAE3FowvdbTqAepdbsZp7jTMKneifEWJsmDc9O4Bhk0DKtYWzSXjSuhe861Up3ngxwVl9o5O3LdN5KDx3Lk7v-BqWwQ4ud4Q-7csbfRbKWc1Nz-NGJuxFxr7Vxa3RU2Yr7UjZi5uviiFzF3JP9yhRhBDMxDgETAqGR8AjFM7NrNLLGSX_vJCOBJ7ATrgHmwsdvKHtts_FkxRqRBN5I_dovxp1D51YtvI74DAAD___V9hwQ), as negotiators continue to work through specific language. President Trump is set to convene a [rare Camp David](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCn0Q6DiOIUFH9jN3-7pbkDV-duEAgwMvP2G_cVtj7JyfnO1329Azny-384UJctrB5rdlgKppUS-FwhefJ7hHcJvpLP4O0quJgYH5lQqwVyn1W2Vm-IAocWda_UbVaTVKp9auyFwNs2j7dZyW0wZuACRovDNqB8yKklfbXxUaieczWOneWTnEculTEwc9U3kqOlElL3HciXJ27uE05MnQlH6_SzlJib4V8jlkYstdZuC-9LceWNWGJwVMjkRiwlvY7ITPAneswsQUJm4IjMwkmWGXiQx8IOxEJ-Z5efWQTHYsKcXwnZnkLNbdI2VnKO8qQayfcDyP2uKX-68NTiJwAA__89z4kf) Cabinet meeting today to discuss next steps in the Iran talks.
## Trump's Redistricting Push Stalls in Two States
President Trump's effort to redraw congressional districts hit two setbacks Tuesday after South Carolina's Senate [rejected a Republican plan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd1gY8-NbUKRxd9OmtFg42CdiwYKTdfbtI-8rpJpipE_fzK_v7dtjxrL_9E9wlOpW4OoZiKBt2Hzpl28Fy376v1TLhaX7EjcppOFCc2m36DG_NzVElwAkzAO4ydqvxRpl7XA4paZHBKWDNkabZbKzTVMUYbbC6NmmAd1NE1raSQir9RiFUYsWyobgF2EnpgREpNrG3xULHZDyu76gjaE-h-wOorOz-QeTK5PrdV1jeYR7xd0zuZ41I2HoTK4fbcgQCGthcu31Dx08-FYzFt95g4idGgbCsnNIqTbiyWPuvJMn4B3KHXs9eT3P2vEG8RaKn5X5MnJoLp4X5ozdWKbE_vSYP570X-e-nPwXAAD___f7kIM) to oust longtime Rep. Jim Clyburn, D-S.C. Also, on Tuesday, a federal court [blocked Alabama](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7mxhjFlcUFzjLtdeaW1g4-wJQwRcuLz9L_-v8HcjzWhG8_257TfkwPH4jSfZ-kh7pFYC1Up554yxNMyR4_HC_zXFxrFg9LsUUg9iGSTsHjl8dtV7-yCSNPdkJ4DVgFYA_dPSfNeTEzOSmYxRhKtzDjWCUStoWHu2V5tYJExCwLKMXmhlFqHAOTQCpk4J8lxTHv8mjvVJj_BJb8qjS2cf7LPWV-nmX53cOrm11kZ3L9eLy-_kdslObi79y3XAgHc8cXApHplK4RQxDJ5LzezqcLKvlM8r32frX41D4KKhU-I4kcP3ZP0Rp7eVXwEAAP__DE5-jw) from using a state-drawn map for the midterms, ruling it relied too heavily on race by including only one majority-black district. Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall said he'd [appeal the ruling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3S2yAURJ9G6tAgzI9cUKRR57QpNdfiIl8HgQawsd8-o7zCV-_Ozp7z57bcgALF7TfsaKtPS8RWAtaKeaEMsTTIkeJ2wKem2CgWiG4RXGjGFRNmcUDhu8jeWY8o8NKjHY25TkZLY_qHRT8q7YxWUkwInHN19SDuQruLmbzyPdlzjSthRs6NUoPjWk6KS7OuMHEzdpKjo5ry8EwU6wN9-KY35mFNex_so9ajdJdfnZg7MbfWBp8-J8WZd2I-UqBKa-nE7NFhhsCeL7chu4e0_i0MAtxhB5bRUamZ1kpxY0eAeDYaq_m1H3227mgUAhVtOsm3HSj8P1B_ZO1txb8AAAD__xmDhAE) to the Supreme Court, where a recent decision made it harder to challenge congressional maps as racially discriminatory. Both parties are racing to [redraw districts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGS3CAQBNCvkTJUCIFYBQROlJ1Th6oRjLRjo0EF3OH7e9fuLzjuqq7X_etj-wCKxOdPuNDVI22MrUSsFfNGGbg0yEx83vC3Jm7EBThsSqpZSCOU3QJQ_N50H9yBqHDq0Y3WLg87a2v7pzO73rX2Si5gjh0WNU7BmsUuMgQ5m6kn92qTRtlRSmvMEOSsH0Zq6z08pB07LTFQTXn4nYjrE4_4nb4wDz5dfXTPWu_STT86tXZqba0NvPvXilfeqfVOkSr50qn1zcaIvlLiTq0HBswQhU-fuYo9Jv-nCIiwwwXisxCf4ky3CBkaC5_4zFgKJYYoLrhF9gyTnpfR9tmFu1GMVGbbaXleQPHtq_916pdT_wIAAP__cTyNGg) ahead of November, with Democrats picking up new seats from California and Utah and Republicans gaining ground in Texas, Florida, and several other states.

Ferrari shares tumbled more than 5% Tuesday after the Italian sports car maker [unveiled the Luce](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvwyAQBeBfg7dY-Iw5MjB08ZauHS0M5-QqAhFGof73lfsXuj3pSZ_03tdtuTmOnO6f7km2bnlJ1PZItVJZuLi0N1cSp_vL_dScGqfdpbCABH2R0wVwCY7jsagu2I0IaOzIDohXg1ohdg97HVEDKE0IjowZ9CgNmG1b3Tqsfhw7tqcmJ8BBSpymPkitzCQVeu-MxEEoSYFrLv135lQftMUjv6n0Pj-7aB-1vnYxfgiYBcyttX5d_dkJmM8xAmZXKvtIZ_TtACghHFPKXbHh1ThG3jUKJe9Px_FPrf-64m3hNwAA__9HRXJD), its first all-electric vehicle and a sharp departure from its signature design language. ## Paxton Defeats Cornyn in Runoff
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton defeated four-term incumbent Sen. John Cornyn in the [Republican Senate primary runoff](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LESnCAQBuCn0W4dQMWzoEhjd2lTOiiLkiAwsHfq22fu8gipd2b___t_Peendt6F7ac-UNFl4xzwLB6JMM9JXxTD6UIhxLA4IgzLXXY9CyYksB7EMBvt_D13tVELMyOvUfFhGB_D-OCy3lXHRtPKkdtVsGU1bLQr9rxbrJX80XOsnfo8Y70YOGdt2zeSYyeGth9bLSSXrOoYGkcxN7Qj4aWL9Xd8Y27WeNRe7USpVO2PSkyVmM7zbGy8PorPvRJTit6RW0slpkNvGii715F2oPw6Emjvb_iDAf5hwaBFTQV-xz3AGnO4A3zlGb7ZsMUEKbtD5xtOneusTDqd967IoerYdmjnv83o__Z8K_E3AAD__9CDjmo) on May 26, winning roughly 62% to 38%. The result ends Cornyn's 24-year Senate career and marks the first time a Texas Republican senator has lost his party's renomination. President Trump endorsed Paxton on May 19, calling him a "true MAGA Warrior." Paxton outperformed Cornyn across the state despite being significantly outspent. Cornyn's campaign and allied groups spent [approximately $109 million](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0b2OnTAQBeCnMZ2v_INtKCjS0G3alGgwwzKJr43M7HJ5-4ibR0h3pJFG59P59TF9ACXKnz_hiQO_1jJlPI-EzFinHV5c8kn5YMQ8EzPm-To2mIwyXionTZgWoHRNbbMMs1p63eCgQ-i70HfaN9swo8LOehsUthqcMh16Pbu1XWzvnZ4bGu5nypmgtbLWPbzG1gTregvGa69Eq3AhLvXBGzK-4FjTVb6xPmJ5NmnYmPdD2B_CjMKM53k-zhXgPgozQmWKCYUZb5cw414SMcU7YsLIVPKd_2CW_7jy9sqK-9ecKEKWe6Un1EvWr1zWVf4uW5ax1Hxl-W4j7_7CjKZz0vcqzh6V7I2zsrUKJMTYyqhXDBa86_XS1GHZT0qJDh9Eqz6fQOlt4f9b4HswfwMAAP__P7qZig) in advertising throughout the campaign compared to Paxton's roughly $10 million. Paxton, who was impeached by the Texas House in 2023 and acquitted by the Texas Senate, now advances to the [general election](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3uozAUxE8DnSN_GxcutkmXbbdED_sRLBmDzNsk3H5F9gj_cjSa0fzmz2N8QC65Pn_DioE-8zZWfB8FibCNO3xoq-9cD0KsUybCOp3HAqPk0jJumHRjglzOUfcpTDx50WMQzvnB-UHYfgmzmYSJs044RMcjtxJMMsYJ55LC6PscrjJupBOCK2VuVqCWThmvQFpheac5pkxbu9GChB845nJuL2y3uK19CQvRfnTqVyfvnbzDfgFc1iUa5Viwk_dvjh1YgZDFrdWzsv94jNrfdWcEBVqOG9MzWO7RpTR5NWkHUaNSfgAhQTuJfQtpf-dS8mFdp_lzhVy-U-hnB76C_BcAAP__EL6FLw) against Democrat James Talarico, a 37-year-old state representative and former teacher. Talarico raised more than $27 million in the first quarter of 2026. The Cook Political Report has [moved the race](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGS3CAQRU-DMk1Bg2AUEDhRtk4dqlpSa4cyAyroWY1u72J9hM1e0PX7__fnY_7AEEP6_I1P8vze85zorJGYqcwHvjmnM6TKRGkJzJSWqz5wBgm2l0MPbt4wxGs23eYXuY2qI6-cG-9uvCvbPby7K0NGLoBuX-Sgl0WZdbSgrDTaoOuCb2FyAKeU1Hq4WUUGnB5GjWCVlcJI2gLncuMHMb2x7vHKX1Rua3520T-Yjyr0LwGTgOk8z9urIucNr3YgYKqcyyVgassETEeOgcPakCKtHHJq3FoImOTQuBGX1_Po_zvo11zSlfrv9315pbzvPWPEEtbcM_4lPPFqMaMEO4AepXQCpq747ThDjKFaJ4z8fGKI3735Z7a_PPwLAAD__9Vhkq0) from "Likely Republican" to "Lean Republican."

Sexual misconduct investigations rose nearly 50%, reaching 441 cases compared to 303 the prior year. The dashboard provides an interactive public view of the investigation and sanction process.
## Dallas Unveils Largest Public Mural for World Cup
Dallas's [largest public mural](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMZ0jswYbFxTX0OXaK9GCl8S6jUH2JiRvf8q9wl9_0mhm_lznKyZO-fYbHzTKe9vnTGdlEqEyH_iWPZ8pVyHKSxKhvHzqHWcw4LTpNfg5YuLP3DVxXEwMbUNj630YfBha19xHb2znQ2y32A82dIABogtmGMjF4DbTpPEbZnrwbWus7S-upQ687YNFcK0zqjMUk-zlIncSemPd-LO_qFzW_dHweBc5qrK_FEwKpvM8L3lZ43Z-WcH03aNg4n1F_vpeOOr1eWgsoiMyY9XP_KLEVa9JPlUzlhtV0cdz4bTqx7MgaxSd6dQHlr8Kps7AYK1TMDVljMeZmFN1XnXm9sDE_5vJz_58jfAvAAD__0jCijs) has been unveiled ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, which kicks off June 11. The piece, titled _One Field, Infinite Smiles_ , was created by internationally acclaimed Dutch artist Rosalie de Graaf alongside several Texas artists and took two weeks to complete. It sits on the Trinity Park Conservancy building. The mural overlooks the future [250-acre Harold Simmons Park](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SrCAURlejGRbgDxoQvMSsXzqhdZVLSxWCA9fG3v1UzxYm_-o7dc7XY3mA8y48_8OBmm4bl4AleyTCtJxwUwzFhUyIYXVEGNZ33mGRXA6M90yqxYDz76WrjV65mUSNWig1jWoaxVDv2nLbKdVDOxmxdr0de2tXAGVxhIm3UDv9OeO9VELwtu2bQWAnVdtPLchBDLzqOBpHMTW0I-EN2fp3fGFqtnjUXu9EZ67af5WcKzmXUhob7-6j8RlUcs5nTJQrOVtngZWYvGHbdTID3kNmx5XAs3wFA2FDlr8vSMhy3DZMbAXvc520OYvz3uVBVR1_HuD8L53-1uyl5U8AAAD__80Sg6o), currently under construction between downtown Dallas, the Design District, and Trinity Groves. He was impeached by his own party on charges of bribery and abuse of power. He bragged about delivering Texas to Trump by blocking mail-in ballots. Ken Paxton in the U.S. Senate would be one of the most dangerous outcomes of the 2026 cycle, handing Trump a key ally in the chamber where the SAVE Act, the most sweeping voter suppression law in American history, is currently being held up. But stopping Paxton is about more than one seat. We recently launched our Unpack Our Courts initiative to reform the Supreme Court by expanding the number of justices and diluting the influence of the right-wing extremists who have gutted the Voting Rights Act, overturned Roe, legalized corruption, and handed Trump criminal immunity. Texas is one of several red-to-blue pickup opportunities we are tracking heading into the midterms. # **Endorsements: Here’s Who’s Standing With Our Campaign**
I wanted to take a moment to share some exciting updates from the campaign.**Over the past few months, we’ve built incredible momentum across Texas’s 8th District.** In addition to our win in the Democratic Primary, that momentum is being recognized by leaders and organizations across our community. I’m proud to have earned the support of a broad coalition who believe in our vision for accountable, people-first leadership.**So far, we’ve received endorsements and distinctions from:**
* The Houston Chronicle
* Houston LGBTQ+ Political Caucus
* Secular Houston
* Progressive Voters Network
* Harris County Young Democrats
* Area 5 Democrats
* Mothers Against Greg Abbott
* Moms Demand Action (Gun Sense Candidate _Designation_)

Each of these represents a different part of our community, and together they reflect something powerful: this campaign is bringing people together.I’m incredibly grateful for this support, but more importantly, I’m energized by what it means—our message is resonating, and our movement is growing.**Now we have to keep that momentum going.****_With your continued support, we can build on this progress, reach more voters, and deliver a win for working families across District 8._**

name: Caitlin Cattelino
subject: Reminder: Arctic Refuge Webinar Tomorrow!
body:
On Thursday, May 28, join Defenders to learn more about efforts to expand drilling in the Arctic Refuge and how your voice can make a difference!

On Thursday, May 28, join Defenders to learn more about efforts to expand drilling in the Arctic Refuge and how your voice can make a difference!
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5551935/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5551936/38SyG9Xl)

Dear Defender,

I wanted to send a friendly reminder about our upcoming webinar on the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge this Thursday, May 28. If you haven’t registered yet, there is still time to do so! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5551937/38SyG9Xl)

The Arctic Refuge, the crown jewel of our refuge system, is home to over 300 animal species and the greatest biodiversity of any protected area north of the Arctic Circle. However, this vast landscape is under extreme threat as the Trump administration is proposing to expand oil and gas drilling here.

Join Defenders to learn more about the incredible Arctic Refuge, its wildlife, and the communities that rely on it. We’ll also discuss how writing meaningful and compelling letters to the editor can help elevate your opposition to destructive oil and gas development in the refuge.

Here are the details:

What: Wildlife Defenders’ Briefing Webinar:

Defend the Arctic Refuge

When: Thursday, May 28

Time: 7:00pmET / 6:00pmCT / 5:00pmMT / 4:00pmPT

Register here – a zoom link will be sent to you (https://support.defenders.org/s/5551938/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5551939/38SyG9Xl)

The Bureau of Land Management is currently accepting bids for oil and gas leases on the Arctic Refuge and the companies submitting these bids need to hear from you! By writing letters to the editor to local newspapers, you can publicly tell these oil and gas companies to stay out of the refuge because drilling there is destructive and risky.

I look forward to working with you to protect the Arctic Refuge and hope to see you tomorrow! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5551940/38SyG9Xl)

Caitlin Cattelino

Director of National Outreach

Defenders of Wildlife

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)

Lynda, my mom, was the OG mom on a mission.
She was the kind of person who simply could not look away when someone was hurting. Throughout my childhood, she raised money for families across the country whose homes had been destroyed by floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, and other extreme weather events. Long before social media made these stories visible every day, my mom was finding ways to help total strangers rebuild their lives.
Even after her illness made her mostly housebound, her compassion for others didn’t change. She still found ways to care for people every day. She would stay on the phone when someone needed to talk. She remembered birthdays and anniversaries, sent cards, checked in, and made sure people knew they were deeply loved.

My mom passed away when my oldest son, Trey, was just under two years old. Today, he’s ten! I think about her often during this campaign, because so many of the lessons I learned from her come up every day on the campaign.
Right now, too many families feel like they are being left behind. Costs are rising, healthcare is becoming more unaffordable, and programs that help vulnerable families are constantly under attack.
I know what this feels like because I’ve lived it. I know what it feels like to watch someone you love struggle while wondering whether the system will help you or leave you behind. And I also know how powerful it is when someone simply shows up and reminds you that you are not alone.
That’s the kind of leadership I believe in.
If you believe families deserve dignity, affordable healthcare, and leaders who will fight for people rather than abandon them, I’m asking you to chip in what you can today. Every dollar helps us buy megaphones for our campaign to spread the word, push back against these cuts, and fight for families who need support the most. Peter, In case you didn’t hear the news yet, I wanted to share with you that I’m launching a new weekly show on SiriusXM called “The John Kasich Show.” Each week, we’ll have honest conversations about politics, faith, and culture. We’ll try to slow things down, cut through the talking points and ideological spin, and get to what really matters.

There is a lot of noise in America right now. A lot of shouting. A lot of people talking past one another. A lot of red team, blue team, my side, your side, and not nearly enough listening. This show is meant to be a place for open minds and respectful conversation, but also a place where we can have some fun. We’ll talk about culture, sports, music, movies, and the people who shape how we live, because these conversations should be entertaining as well as meaningful.

This past weekend, [I spoke with former U.S. Senator Joe Manchin](http://links.johnkasich.com/s/c/LiKM91BumQ3bXvCC6sYbmaQstWALRfmDV-JpY39xH_2RKDsndG7ClvxGJzANHtWozVVwS_kHXF98vaS2aV5Mz9KSv3-Ay1ka0vxwhfEBc-9gbajZOp1hm9jKh3u4iGjInoH3Dsh4eFH_iqNQlaom8l9q_kCQIB5AhXd7r4btvB-dNeySufZIoe8Cm_PfR5LR8TB0zQx8EgbZiXHpz9tLVh2CD90D_tOFWlOK-rqL1IhcpwEiw8oL-bfXgh5NTm6RR0SdWj6SEsep_zEY09MU_w80yvyntlmwuH8BuWi4hvf0xqC_XwWVItV8wVFuyv20SLP81bPbpSE_-XKYqOfOY_thHDJFwHUtzfiMcVRV833FZhgUoRCWJqPDvob8ubEJKKvDckIoCn9q/sACKkOhwriVF44JsopUE3pkyLRLUDEba/21) on the premier episode. Joining Steve is the Executive Director of We Heart Seattle an action-based, boots-on-the-ground movement that organizes trash cleanups in our public spaces and offers resources to those in need. Through our direct civic engagement, we lead the way to a more compassionate and healthy community.
Thousands of people are fighting to survive outside often in cold, wet weather at a time when thousands of clean, warm, and hygienic indoor spaces are available in King County. Tragically, many people suffering in unhealthy, unsanitary conditions are dying. We Heart Seattle's proven model of trash removal and individualized outreach, coupled with community engagement, has resulted in the restoration and maintenance of many parks across the city. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

subject: JUNE 9th PRIMARY PARTY INVITATION
body:
Hi Team Mark Smith for Congress,

🇺🇲We are officially LESS than 2 weeks away from the 2026 Primary Election! 🇺🇲

Every phone call made, every door knocked, and every handshake has led to this moment. Mark and the team could not be more grateful for the amazing group of volunteers that we've been blessed with. Thank you to each and every one of you for the time, talent, and energy you've shared with this campaign thus far.

We couldn't imagine celebrating this night without you. Please see your official Watch Party invitation attached, as well as the RSVP link. We'll be celebrating at New Realm Brewing on Daniel Island (a true full-circle moment for those who attended the launch back in August!)

You MUST RSVP to attend. Please feel free to invite your friends and family! 🎉
**RSVP LINK:[https://marksmithprimaryparty.eventbrite.com](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://marksmithprimaryparty.eventbrite.com&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1780335377825557&usg=AOvVaw2K7UBoZGT4MR-mTYqz31dw)**

It is ALL HANDS ON DECK these final weeks._**We need more phone bankers and door knockers to drive this home on June 9th**_. If you are willing and able to help, please send me your availability for making calls and door knocking as soon as possible and we'll get you plugged in. It is imperative that we keep up the momentum going into the election - all gas, no brakes!

Again, thank you to each and every one of you for being a part of the Mark Smith for Congress team. We truly couldn't do this without you.

Best Regards,

Alexa Jones
Political Director

Mark Smith for Congress

E - [alexa@votemarksmith.com](mailto:alexa@votemarksmith.com)

body:

**_“I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don’t think about anybody.”_**
That’s what President Donald Trump said when asked whether he thought about Americans’ financial situation as he considered a deal to end his reckless and inflationary war with Iran, Peter.
And when his hand-picked candidate for North Carolina’s Senate seat was asked whether he backed President Trump’s ongoing war, given the squeeze it’s putting on folks here in North Carolina, Michael Whatley said **“absolutely.”**
Peter, if he wins this seat, it will come at the expense of North Carolina’s working families.
**[But by chipping in $5 now to our campaign, you can help Roy Cooper stop that from happening.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11946?amount=5&t=8&akid=1515%2E124072%2Eq8utel)**

It comes as no surprise that Whatley’s on board with the Trump-first, America-last agenda. Going on the record about it is politically unwise, though, so instead of relying on him to win this race on his own merits, the GOP is spending tens of millions to try to buy it for him – **and a recent poll now shows the race statistically tied.**
But moments like these go to show just how important this grassroots team is, Peter. MAGA will go to any lengths to please President Trump and protect their one-party rule over Washington DC, so Roy’s relying on the collective power of folks like **you** behind him to fight back.
**[If you’re in a place to give today, will you please chip in $5 or more now to help us win the biggest Senate race in the country, break the GOP’s grip on North Carolina’s Senate seat and return power to the people when we flip the Senate majority blue?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11946?amount=5&t=13&akid=1515%2E124072%2Eq8utel)**

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

Here is a quick look at who will be on the ballot on June 9th:

🗳️ **Nicole Cannizzaro for Attorney General –** Nicole is the only Democrat running for NV Attorney General who has ever tried a case or represented a client in court, and she is the only candidate of either party who has a record of defending personal rights and freedoms – including abortion and reproductive rights. Meanwhile, her Republican opponents’ priorities include ending DEI programs.

🗳️ **Sandra Jauregui for Lieutenant Governor –** Sandra was the Majority Leader of the state Assembly in 2023 and was the primary co-sponsor for the Nevada Constitutional amendment to protect abortion access. Her opponent has wasted valuable time creating the “Task Force” to “Protect Women’s Sports” and is facing an ethics violation for the misuse of public resources...

🗳️ **Ashley Delobel for Assembly District 29 -** Ashley is the only woman running against 4 male opponents, including Christian Bishop (a former contestant on The Bachelorette), who previously ran for a state senate seat but had to drop out due to mounting sexual misconduct allegations.

Plus, she was voted the Southern Nevada Building Trades Woman of the Year in 2024. Venise’s priorities include keeping Nevada women safe and protecting reproductive rights as more people from surrounding states are depending on NV for care.

🗳️ **Gabriella Wyett for Assembly District 41 -** This has been called a “must-win” competitive primary election. Gabriella is a single mother facing off against 2 men. With over 20 years of service, and as Chair of the Nevada Commission on Minority Affairs, she is the most qualified person in the race.

🗳️ **Daniele Monroe-Moreno for North Las Vegas Mayor –** As a State Assemblymember, Daniele was the first Black woman to serve as Speaker Pro Tempore, Chair of the Ways and Means Committee, and Chair of the Nevada Democratic Party. Despite Speaker Monroe-Moreno’s stellar reputation in NV and objective qualifications, her male opponent, who entered the race before her, managed to scoop up a number of endorsements. We’re hoping to offset his advantage.

**These races aren’t just about Nevada.** They will have a much bigger impact on what happens in 2028 and beyond. The strength we build in these local and statewide races – putting forth incredible women with real experience and a strong understanding of what their communities need – will help build momentum, strengthen female leadership, grow infrastructure, and more.

All of that starts in these upcoming primary elections.

body:
Money taken from working family paychecks and funneled into activism. The swamp killed DOGE. I'm bringing it back.

| | | | | [|
---](https://ericburlisonforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b6500a115da3c4344522b1e48&id=823fc7c24c&e=5f9dc01b8c)
| | Peter ,
**When I go back home to MO-07, the small talk is about DOGE.** Not the weather. Not the Cardinals. DOGE.People at the gas station, at the diner, and at church on Sunday. They walk up and tell me the same thing. They were excited. For the first time in a long time, somebody in Washington actually believed what they believe. Somebody was opening the books. Asking the questions nobody was supposed to ask. Auditing the agencies that had spent decades operating without a single hard look.That was a once-in-a-generation moment. And the swamp killed it.**Here's what they did not want you to see.** A lot of what DOGE was uncovering was not just inefficient spending. It was evil. I mean that word.Money taken out of working family paychecks - yours, mine, the guy who fixed my truck last month - and funneled into projects those families would never, in a million years, voluntarily pay for. Activism dressed up with a science label. Ideology with a federal grant number stamped on it. Political agendas being funded by people who would be furious if they knew where their tax dollars were actually going.That's not a budgeting problem. That's a theft problem. The federal government has been quietly converting paychecks into activism for decades, and DOGE was about to put the whole operation on the front page.So they killed it.**Think about who that tells you was running scared.** The people who run the agencies. The people who write the grants. The people who decide which "researchers" get funded and which ones don't. They were not upset that DOGE found waste. They were upset that DOGE was about to make the public understand the racket.And when the swamp gets nervous, it has tools. The press. The lobbyists. | |
| | | | | | **Last week I testified at the Senate hearing on redistricting about the proposed map splitting the City of Spartanburg in half.**[**You can see my full testimony here**](https://us.list-manage.com/TtdLmP6CPK1?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)**, and read my remarks below.**

| My name is Kathryn Harvey. I serve as the chair of the Spartanburg County Democratic Party- but today I’m here as a concerned resident of the city of Spartanburg.
This Bill would cut my city and county into two Congressional Districts - moving the entire Eastside of Spartanburg, Pacolet, Cowpens into Congressional District 5. We will share a Congressional District with Rock Hill instead of our neighboring county of Greenville.
This map would split city council representation, county council representation, our District 7 schools, and several precincts into two congressional districts.
It would also draw 700 people out of the town of Lyman, just one precinct would have a different congressional representative than the other 8,000 residents. And instead of driving to a Congressional field office 15 min away in Greer they will have to drive 90 minutes to Rock Hill.
As someone who led our countywide 2020 Census efforts in Spartanburg and ran as the Democratic Nominee for Congress in 2024, I can tell you that this is sheer insanity. And I will remind you that 2020 was an undercount and our population has boomed.
The city of Spartanburg has an estimated population of about 40,000 residents, while the broader Spartanburg County area is home to nearly 400,000
By 2030 we'll be well on our way to half a million.
At a time when we as a community are bringing more business in than nearly any other county in the state, when nearly 30 people move to our county every day, when we have generational investment in education which receives federal funding, and when our community is finally getting our dues...you're going to divide us.
And as far as political power and representation: I can also tell you that the likelihood anyone like Liz Patterson or Trey Gowdy who were Congressional representatives from Spartanburg ever serving again in this new district is very low. It will dilute our political power in every way shape and form.
But what I’m most concerned about is the confusion it will cause for voters. I’ve spent nearly a decade working locally to inform, educate, and turn out voters and I can ensure you this will not only dilute trust in government which is at an all time low, but also put undue stress on an already taxed election system.
People get confused when their polling place moves, now their whole congressional district is going to move on top of it.
Voters should choose their elected officials. Elected officials should not choose their voters.
And finally I’ll leave you with this:
Every single one of you has been a candidate and a voter. I want you to go home tonight and try to put yourself in the shoes of the current candidates and voters you'll disenfranchise and ask yourself if you'd want this done to you.
This map truly is a menace.

McAdams swiftly responded saying "You are a protester who's been out here and you have a dirty mouth" and telling viewers "that's just what we deal with...it's constant with this, it's what these people do." Anti-ICE protests escalate at 1,000-bed facility as Democratic politicians visit : Demonstrations at Newark's Delaney Hall have intensified for fifth straight day fueled by New Jersey's progressive politicians, with Sen. Andy Kim and Reps. Rob Menendez and Nellie Pou touring the facility while Gov. Mikie Sherrill visited over weekend. Detainees allegedly received tainted food, faced packed rooms without air conditioning and experienced delayed immigration proceedings, according to New Jersey Monitor reporting. ICE disputes detention condition allegations, claims standards exceed U.S. prisons : Federal immigration enforcement disputed allegations regarding facility conditions, stating through social media that detention centers maintain "higher detention standards than most U.S. prisons that hold actual U.S. citizens." Trump celebrates Paxton 's 27-point Texas Senate runoff victory over Cornyn, pledges rally support President Donald Trump congratulated Ken Paxton on his decisive Texas Senate GOP runoff win Tuesday, where the conservative hard-liner defeated Sen. John Cornyn by over 27 points with 63.8% of the vote. "Congratulations to Ken Paxton on such a tremendous win" while praising Cornyn's career saying he "will remain my friend for a long time to come." Trump's long-awaited endorsement came last Tuesday after weeks of teasing as congressional GOP establishment pushed him to back Cornyn, with Trump calling Paxton "a fighter" who "knows how to WIN" in his endorsement message. Trump attacks Democratic nominee Talarico as "worst TEXAS candidate," compares to cartoon character: The president savagely criticized state Rep. James Talarico, whom Paxton will face in November, comparing him to cartoon character Alfred E. Neuman and calling him a "strong Open Borders advocate" who is "WEAK ON CRIME," believes in more than 2 genders, disrespects Christianity and was "a big Mask Wearer" and vegan. Trump said Talarico would be worse for Democrats than their primary challenger Rep. Jasmine Crockett, calling her "a very low IQ individual." You're currently a free subscriber to . In a time when national headlines dominate our attention and social media amplifies every move made in Washington, it's easy to overlook the level of government that most directly impacts our daily lives. Yet the truth is simple and profound: local government matters more than you think. From the roads you drive on, to the schools your children attend, to the safety of your neighborhoods and the cost of your utilities--many of the decisions that shape your everyday life are made not in the halls of Congress, but in city council chambers, county board meetings, and state commissions. The closer the government is to the people, the more accountable it is supposed to be. That was not an accident. It was by design.

The updated Mississippi Freedom Index for the 2026 legislative session is now live.

At the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, we believe transparency matters — and Mississippians deserve an easy way to understand how their elected officials voted on the issues that shape our state.

The newly updated Freedom Index was designed to make legislative information more accessible, searchable, and understandable for everyday voters.

• Search your legislator by name, address, or ZIP code

body:
Court rules it's unconstitutional to allow those who never lived in NC to vote there |
---
| |
---
| | **RITE Prevails in Challenge to North Carolina “Never Resident” Voting Scheme**
**RALEIGH, N.C.** — Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”) today announced a major victory for election integrity in North Carolina. A state court granted summary judgment in _Kivett v. North Carolina State Board of Elections_ , ruling in favor of the plaintiffs and holding that North Carolina’s practice of allowing certain overseas individuals who have never resided in the state to vote in North Carolina federal, state, and local elections violates the state constitution.

The lawsuit was brought by RITE-supported individual voters, alongside the Republican National Committee (RNC) and the North Carolina Republican Party.

The court’s ruling rejects the theory that a state may extend the franchise to individuals who have never established residency within its borders. The challenged policy permitted certain overseas citizens born abroad to vote in North Carolina elections despite never having lived in the state. This ruling does nothing to impact the rights of military and overseas voters eligible to vote under the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act.

“Residency requirements are a fundamental constitutional safeguard,” said RITE President & CEO Justin Riemer. “This ruling reaffirms a basic principle: North Carolina elections are for North Carolina residents. The state constitution’s residency requirement still means something, and states remain bound by their own constitutional limits when determining voter qualifications.”

RITE PAC, RITE’s affiliated political committee, is supporting similar pending suits alongside the RNC in Arizona and Virginia which challenge state statutes that unconstitutionally enfranchise individuals who have never resided in those respective states. ###

In 18 months as Attorney General of NC, almost no case has filled my inbox like this one.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0ec94a03-879a-474b-86f2-ddaef1b89403?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
