Press conference with some of the victims in the wedding photography case.
Our office handles big stuff: fentanyl trafficking, monopoly cases (like Ticketmaster), robocalls, price-fixing, FEMA. All told, we've got about 10,000 active cases.
But the case I've heard the most lately - _by far_ \- concerns a local wedding photography company.
Which tells you how badly this company treated people.
I give you, _Holly Christina Photography._
Nearly 200 couples are out about $1m. Here's what happened.
This company sold wedding photo and video packages that cost about $6,000. They used some version of the same sales line over and over: "Better hurry up and book - we've only got one spot left!"
But it wasn't the last spot.
Turns out, they were double- and triple-booking weddings on the same day. Two dates had _five_ weddings booked for one day.
Sometimes, a completely different photographer would show up.
Sometimes, the right photographer would show up, and they'd take pictures - _but never hand them over._ And then they'd keep the deposit, which was thousands of dollars.
Then in January, the company shut down. No refunds. And they kept taking deposits right until they closed.
When they closed, dozens of couples were less than 90 days out from their wedding, which meant they had to scramble to find a new photographer _without_ the deposit money they already paid.
That's when our office got an _avalanche_ of complaints. At first, it was about 100, then 150, now we're over 200.
So we immediately opened an investigation, gathered a lot of strong evidence from the couples who had been scammed, and took this company to court.
The case is still pending, _but_ we just got a good court order that goes into effect immediately.
It does three things.
First, they have to hand over every photo and every video they're sitting on. All the edited galleries, all the raw footage, everything. Within 30 days.
Second, all their assets are frozen while the court figures out how to make it right with these couples.
Third, they're not allowed to provide any photography or videography services.
And that's just a partial ruling while the full case is still pending. We're going back to court for refunds, civil penalties, and a permanent shutdown.
Why are we making this case a priority?

Because either we live in a state where you can mistreat people, or we don't. These couples will never get their wedding day back. But they should know we're making their fight our own and every business that serves the public should know we stand with consumers when they're mistreated.
Here's [our video](https://substack.com/redirect/eacc7f30-9b62-461d-aa73-184a2c0eb0c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explaining the situation in detail, and I'll keep you posted.
### You've been Paying Illegal Chicken Prices
We just stopped a hidden system that made you pay more for chicken, pork, and turkey.
It lasted years. Here's how it worked.
The biggest meat producers in the country, every week, were sending private data on their prices and production volume to a company called Agri Stats.
Then Agri Stats turned around and sent reports back to those same producers showing exactly where each company ranked against its competitors - and where they could raise prices.
And none of that information was public. Grocery stores didn't have it. Restaurants didn't have it. Just meat producers.
In other words, companies that were supposed to be competing against each other were using Agri Stats to compare private pricing information to coordinate higher prices.
That's illegal.
If all these meat producers had sat in a back room and passed around their internal pricing data, everyone would understand the problem. Using an outside company to do it for them doesn't make it legal.
And the scale was massive. We're talking roughly 90% of chicken, 90% of turkey, and 80% of pork - so whether you were buying at a grocery store or a restaurant, it was almost all downstream of this scheme to make you pay more.
So we teamed up with five other AGs - from both parties - and USDOJ, and we took them on.
Now we can announce that we have officially brought this practice to an end.
We're getting a court order that blocks them from doing this and, because we really don't trust them, there's going to be a court-ordered monitor looking over their shoulder to make sure they don't try it again.
There are also class action lawsuits to go after the money that the producers overcharged, so there's more accountability than just our effort, but our effort means we have cut off this pipeline of secret information that was built to raise prices on you, and that never should have existed in the first place.
Here's our [video](https://substack.com/redirect/630fdd4b-bd7b-4acf-a0c4-a86a64fe87ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) which goes into more detail:

But the case I've heard the most lately - by far \- concerns a local wedding photography company. Which tells you how badly this company treated people. I give you, Holly Christina Photography. Nearly 200 couples are out about $1m. Here's what happened. This company sold wedding photo and video packages that cost about $6,000. They used some version of the same sales line over and over: "Better hurry up and book - we've only got one spot left!" But it wasn't the last spot. Turns out, they were double- and triple-booking weddings on the same day. Two dates had five weddings booked for one day. Sometimes, a completely different photographer would show up. Sometimes, the right photographer would show up, and they'd take pictures - but never hand them over. And then they'd keep the deposit, which was thousands of dollars. Then in January, the company shut down. No refunds. And they kept taking deposits right until they closed. When they closed, dozens of couples were less than 90 days out from their wedding, which meant they had to scramble to find a new photographer without the deposit money they already paid. That's when our office got an avalanche of complaints. At first, it was about 100, then 150, now we're over 200. So we immediately opened an investigation, gathered a lot of strong evidence from the couples who had been scammed, and took this company to court. The case is still pending, but we just got a good court order that goes into effect immediately. It does three things. First, they have to hand over every photo and every video they're sitting on. All the edited galleries, all the raw footage, everything. Within 30 days. Second, all their assets are frozen while the court figures out how to make it right with these couples. Third, they're not allowed to provide any photography or videography services. And that's just a partial ruling while the full case is still pending. We're going back to court for refunds, civil penalties, and a permanent shutdown. Why are we making this case a priority? Because either we live in a state where you can mistreat people, or we don't. These couples will never get their wedding day back. But they should know we're making their fight our own and every business that serves the public should know we stand with consumers when they're mistreated. Here's explaining the situation in detail, and I'll keep you posted. You've been Paying Illegal Chicken Prices We just stopped a hidden system that made you pay more for chicken, pork, and turkey. It lasted years. Here's how it worked. The biggest meat producers in the country, every week, were sending private data on their prices and production volume to a company called Agri Stats. Then Agri Stats turned around and sent reports back to those same producers showing exactly where each company ranked against its competitors - and where they could raise prices. And none of that information was public. Grocery stores didn't have it. Restaurants didn't have it. Just meat producers. In other words, companies that were supposed to be competing against each other were using Agri Stats to compare private pricing information to coordinate higher prices. That's illegal. If all these meat producers had sat in a back room and passed around their internal pricing data, everyone would understand the problem. Using an outside company to do it for them doesn't make it legal. And the scale was massive. We're talking roughly 90% of chicken, 90% of turkey, and 80% of pork - so whether you were buying at a grocery store or a restaurant, it was almost all downstream of this scheme to make you pay more. So we teamed up with five other AGs - from both parties - and USDOJ, and we took them on. Now we can announce that we have officially brought this practice to an end. We're getting a court order that blocks them from doing this and, because we really don't trust them, there's going to be a court-ordered monitor looking over their shoulder to make sure they don't try it again. There are also class action lawsuits to go after the money that the producers overcharged, so there's more accountability than just our effort, but our effort means we have cut off this pipeline of secret information that was built to raise prices on you, and that never should have existed in the first place. Here's our which goes into more detail: | | ---|---|--- We just announced another big case this week, but this email is already long enough so I'll save it for next week. Wishing you well and have a great week. Best, Jeff Jackson Attorney General, North Carolina P.S. - Last weekend, I told Avery and Owen I had a surprise for them after my monthly drill with Army National Guard... | | ---|---|--- Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Army or the Department of Defense. ... and it was tacos! | | ---|---|--- Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Army or the Department of Defense. Dear Peter,
I want to tell you about Dr. Adam Hamawy – and why I’m proud to endorse him for Congress in New Jersey’s 12th District.
Dr. Hamawy is a surgeon, Army veteran, humanitarian, and small business owner who has dedicated his life to serving others. Over the past two years, he went on multiple medical missions to Gaza and has spoken out courageously about the devastating human cost of war and what our tax dollars are enabling.
Back home in New Jersey, Dr. Hamawy runs a medical practice in the Princeton area, where he sees every day how broken our healthcare system has become. He understands what working families are up against because he sees it firsthand.
He’s running on a vision rooted in justice, dignity, and compassion. We share the goal of creating an economy where everybody can succeed and nobody is left behind. We understand the importance of passing Medicare for All and protecting our environment.
I look forward to working alongside Dr. Hamawy on these issues because we need more members of Congress who are willing to step up and fight for working people instead of corporations and special interests.
But first, we need to get him to Congress.
If we want leaders who will fight for healthcare, justice, and working families, we have to help elect them.

clean_body: Our end-of-month deadline can't wait. | = Friend, I know your time is precious, but I need just two minutes for something that can't wait: Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is coming up fast, and my team says we need to bring in more donations from folks like you to meet our ambitious $40,000 goal before Sunday at midnight. = | = = I understand you get a lot of emails and texts asking for money, and that they always seem to be up against a deadline. The truth is, we don't have special interests or oil barons in our corner. What we do have is YOU — and a people-powered movement that truly believes we can leave a healthy planet for future generations. Every race we're investing in right now is possible because of your continued support. It keeps organizers in the field. It helps us fight back against Big Oil's lies online and on the airwaves. It means we can show up for brave climate leaders who refuse to bend the knee to the fossil fuel industry— and help them WIN. And right now, that work could not be more urgent. We're less than six months out from Election Day, with dozens of our endorsed climate champions running in high-stakes races right now that will determine whether we keep going down this destructive path of authoritarianism — or hold the line, protect our communities, and put a real check on Donald Trump and every autocratic force behind him. We have to keep going. When I leave this place, I want my grandkids to know that I did everything in my power to create a livable future for them. I have no choice but to dig even deeper in the pursuit of a better future by electing leaders who will meet this moment with the urgency it demands. So I need to know you're with me. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for being part of this fight. xx Jane | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Below is the death threat I just received, sent by the Libertarian Party of New Hampshire to me and then amplified to their account of 100,000 followers.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]
It’s clear what they want to do — incite someone to hurt me or my family.
I’m Christian Urrutia, the Democrat running for Congress in NH-01, America's most vulnerable open blue seat. I'm an economic populist and a first-generation Mexican-American son of immigrants. An Army officer. And someone who still believes in this country enough to fight for it.
To the far-right someone like me attaining elected office is an existential threat.
These type of extremists showed up to an event I spoke at waving Nazi flags trying to stop me from speaking (I gave my speech anyways). They send me messages telling me that my life may “abruptly come to an end.” They send me pictures of nooses.
Because they hate me, they hate us, and they hate our vision.
This isn’t just about me. It’s about whether we let hate and political violence take root here in America. Or whether we stand up and say no. You know where I stand. But I can’t do this alone.
If you can, please make a donation to help us beef up security for my staff and I so we can continue rolling with the punches. Whether it's $50, $20, or even just $10 it will have an outsized impact. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]
DONATE TODAY!>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-nh1]
Thank you in advance for your support at this inflection point for our campaign.
Christian Urrutia

| Hi friend, Juan here– **SIGNS ARE UP** across Arizona's Sixth Congressional District, major wins are being delivered, and our campaign continues to grow as we continue to focus on **RESULTS**. From standing with law enforcement to fighting for Veterans and securing major economic wins for Southern Arizona, we’re putting in the work every single day for the people of this district. Here are a few big updates from this week 👇
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=903028056e&e=659fba240e)
---
|
---
| **HELPING VETERANS BECOME HOMEOWNERS ** My colleague, Rep. Derrick Van Orden, and I have been fighting to make the American Dream more accessible to the men and women who served our country. That’s why we introduced the bipartisan **VA Home Loan Affordability Act** to cut red tape, modernize the VA home loan process, and make it easier for veterans and military families to buy a home. Right now, outdated regulations and a shortage of certified VA appraisers are creating unnecessary delays for veterans trying to buy a home. Our legislation streamlines the process, removes outdated barriers, and aligns VA standards with other federal housing programs, helping veterans access homeownership faster and more affordably. Our veterans earned these benefits through their service, and they shouldn’t have to jump through hoops to use them. Arizona's Sixth Congressional District is home to a strong military and veteran community, and I’ll keep fighting to ensure they have the support and opportunities they deserve.
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=11014f07e4&e=659fba240e)
---
|
---
| **🇺🇸 BIG WIN FOR FORT HUACHUCA** After more than a year of fighting to bring a new mission to Fort Huachuca, we got it **DONE.** Fort Huachuca is already one of the most important military and intelligence assets in the country — and this new mission further cements Southern Arizona’s role at the forefront of America’s national security. This **WIN** means: ✅ More good-paying jobs
✅ More investment in Cochise County
✅ Stronger support for local businesses
✅ Greater long-term stability for Fort Huachuca’s existing $3+ billion economic impact
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=3858db4e50&e=659fba240e)
---
|
---
| **ENDORSED BY THE ARIZONA POLICE ASSOCIATION** Last week, I had the privilege of being ENDORSED by the Arizona Police Association during National Police Week! I’ll always back the men and women who put on the badge and work every day to keep our communities safe. Strong public safety policies and resources for our law enforcement will always be a top priority to keep Southern Arizona the best and safest place to live and raise a family.

**THANK YOU, Arizona Police Association, for your support! **
---
| [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=59527d550a&e=659fba240e)

|

– Juan

### It's been a rough year if you care about democracy. I was reminded recently--at a funeral, of all places--that it's worth staying in the fight.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)

Notwithstanding [some good news yesterday](https://substack.com/redirect/e24fbaf1-069b-47f5-85c5-2809e42bc348?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), if you're someone who thinks that gerrymandering is bad, it's been a rough couple of months.
I've written extensively about gerrymandering before--not just because [my own run for Congress ended in '22](https://substack.com/redirect/30f25abe-5847-4d42-b2f9-2645bcd68daa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because of gerrymandering--and why it's bad for _everyone_ in America.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/388ffb04-9967-4266-8988-9b3428e95039?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |
#### [America's Coalition of Losers](https://substack.com/redirect/388ffb04-9967-4266-8988-9b3428e95039?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/profile/12425779-ben-samuels)| | *
---|---|---
| November 12, 2025
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/388ffb04-9967-4266-8988-9b3428e95039?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But what we're experiencing now is much worse than anything in modern American history. Republicans will favorably redraw more seats than Democrats ahead of the '26 midterm elections, though I still think Democrats will win the U.S. House.
The long-term prognosis concerns me much more: vanishingly few competitive seats, perpetual gerrymanders, and more extreme politics. All of this had me feeling quite pessimistic: what's the point?
As some of you may know, Ray Hartmann--a longtime figure in St. Louis media and politics--[died last month](https://substack.com/redirect/75016512-ef6a-471a-98a9-366f59f133d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a freak car accident.
I went to his funeral in the throes of some rather intense nihilism at all the gerrymandering and at the state of our politics, and I was reminded of something important: America is deeply flawed and imperfect, but cynicism gets us nowhere. It's still worth fighting for what's right.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTk3MTI5Mjg1LCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzc5ODk2ODgyLCJleHAiOjIwOTU0NzI4ODIsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.iuQ8pm5sQ9qRGCimGWW8mYsohciZuYLfOIskF_1UZtY?)
> _**Article summary:**_
> * _Perpetual gerrymandering is here. It 's not obvious to me which party will "win," but it is obvious that the American people will lose._
> * _Ending partisan gerrymandering is overwhelmingly popular. We 've pulled off much more challenging democracy reforms before, and unlike changes in the past, fixing this only requires an act of Congress, not a constitutional amendment._
>

### Ray Hartmann was difficult, loud, and committed to justice
I didn't know Ray particularly well, but we did have a lot in common.
Most notably, we both tried (and failed) to unseat Ann Wagner in Missouri-02. Missouri Democratic politics is a small world and we would run into each other periodically. When I ran for Congress, he was kind to me when he didn't have to be, making intros and having me on his radio show a couple of times.
If variety is the spice of life, Ray was a Carolina Reaper.1 He was a speechwriter for Kit Bond; he ran two different publications, the _Riverfront Times_ 2 and _St. Louis Magazine_ ; he spent a [few decades yelling on ](https://substack.com/redirect/8b6569f9-f4b0-4981-85c0-5194f5b972d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Donnybrook](https://substack.com/redirect/8b6569f9-f4b0-4981-85c0-5194f5b972d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ ; he started a family around the age of 50 and had two kids; he went bankrupt; he ran for Congress; he had all sorts of (mis)adventures.
I'd known most of this before I went to the funeral. What I hadn't known was that [his mom, as a nine-year-old, left Nazi Germany](https://substack.com/redirect/ee2ca2f3-b622-48b6-8648-33b59cefd4bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the support of the [German Jewish Children's Aid](https://substack.com/redirect/f4a2a1a9-1fe7-4d3c-ab33-cdea321952c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) program. Ray's aunt, grandmother, and grandfather were all murdered in Auschwitz. But his mom survived because a family in University City took her in.3
**His family history is a testament to humanity 's capacity for evil, and also what America can be at its best.**
Growing up with a mother whose family had been murdered instilled in Ray a desire to fight for justice. As every eulogist noted--including his children--he was an ideologue, unwilling to back down when he believed he was right. That's how you end up running for Congress in a [seat you know you're going to lose](https://substack.com/redirect/276df529-c3e0-4acf-8229-19f2ff49ebc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Politics is full of people who flap in the wind to keep their jobs, to survive another election.4 Ray Hartmann ran for Congress because he truly cared. He really wanted to engage with voters; he really wanted to change people's minds. Ray wasn't upbeat, but insofar as he believed he could make things better, he was an optimist.
Here's why I'm bringing this up: amidst all the attacks on our democracy, it's hard to have that optimism.
Below, I'll walk through where all of this gerrymandering is headed. But I'll end on a positive note: change is possible. We've realized more difficult reforms before, including ones that were much more outlandish in the context of their time.
We have something to learn from Ray's brand of hopefulness.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=197129285&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3MTI5Mjg1LCJpYXQiOjE3Nzk4OTY4ODIsImV4cCI6MTc4MjQ4ODg4MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.FSYSKqBhRhQbozQaVBhVZqm24RRyGTVJaV-BJvCZKUw)
### Who cares about persuasion when you can change the ground rules?
Once you start to grapple with the scale of what's happening right now, it's easy to let the despair set in.
[92% of U.S. House races](https://substack.com/redirect/92885395-93da-4b2b-b0fc-2ed9a73ae34d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are functionally decided in the primary. That number will likely go up after the '26 elections, because more states will draw away swing districts and districts whose partisan lean they don't like.
This redistricting stuff changes all the time--much more in the footnotes5--but **there 's a chance that as many as 68% of the states that have the structural ability to gerrymander themselves do so**.6 This is imprecise and subject to change, but it's a fairly maximalist look at what could happen by the 2028 elections:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3f8fc38c-ba9a-4bba-8c91-6149085d65ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
See [footnote #5](https://substack.com/redirect/aec01c57-cbff-4985-b2f6-9750b6d4b1b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for more information.
It's the sort of thing that makes politics feel pointless; why bother with ideas or persuasion when we can just draw the districts we like?
The chart above undercounts Republican gains, because a lot of the swing seats here--in Florida, North Carolina, Ohio, and Texas--are still Republican-leaning, and are really only flippable with the best candidates and under the best conditions for Democrats.
There's also a decent amount of guesswork; legislative negotiations can be black boxes, especially at the state level where there isn't much local media coverage.
In any event, the scale of this is unsettling, and we've opened Pandora's Box. Unless something changes, we're barreling towards a universe where gerrymandering will happen every two years. Don't like what happened in the last elections? Just tweak the lines; that'll solve it.
My best guess, looking ahead to the 2028 elections, is that neither party will gain a huge edge. If anything, I can see a world where Democrats give themselves an edge in the House.
But this is all really, really bad. When the parties are truly competitive, they have to change and adapt. They have to meet voters where they are. The more we gerrymander, the more extreme parties become, and the more elected officials only have to worry about primary voters.
I've felt plenty nihilistic about all of this.
### So with all of this happening, why bother?
Against almost impossible headwinds, extraordinary things are still possible. Women [won the right to vote](https://substack.com/redirect/51001a87-99af-43c8-bea9-77ea6cd3b045?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) without even having the right to vote. [So did Native Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/4297e02c-5f9a-4c65-9d0e-34ef31459de5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [African-Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/4d829189-922f-47dc-9818-46d16f8413bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).7 When I was in high school, the idea that gay marriage would be legal [was a pipe dream](https://substack.com/redirect/c5e391dc-a4e4-402b-ac8d-51228c990b6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Proposition 8](https://substack.com/redirect/40b3e4c4-9f7b-4ece-8521-05797362e354?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a ban on gay marriage, passed in _California_ in 2008, which is crazy to think about.8
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=197129285&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk3MTI5Mjg1LCJpYXQiOjE3Nzk4OTY4ODIsImV4cCI6MTc4MjQ4ODg4MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.FSYSKqBhRhQbozQaVBhVZqm24RRyGTVJaV-BJvCZKUw)
**Ending gerrymandering is comparatively simple.** It doesn't require a constitutional amendment, merely an act of Congress. And unlike the changes above, it starts out from a much different baseline: [an overwhelming majority of Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/705bb83c-5ef4-4c54-975a-a1de06967a0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of all stripes believe that partisan gerrymandering is bad.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/705bb83c-5ef4-4c54-975a-a1de06967a0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Cynicism is easy. Optimism requires work. But in this case, it helps that the American people are in agreement.
The solution here will have to come at the federal level; when states act alone, it's a race to the bottom. But we can fix this--perhaps not overnight, perhaps not with this Congress, but Americans have overcome much larger obstacles.
What makes this issue tricky is that it [requires politicians to vote against their self-interest](https://substack.com/redirect/8c58b480-e45f-4be6-a82e-4493e4c37342?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Even then, when the groundswell is substantial enough, **elected officials have voted against their self-interest before** , for instance:
* [Creating the right to citizen-initiated ballot measures](https://substack.com/redirect/e6a8c15f-7d7f-40fc-a20b-599244a38289?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Passing the [Seventeenth Amendment](https://substack.com/redirect/131ca217-f6cf-429e-9688-edf98c19fb4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* [Creating financial disclosures for members of Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/f0b6fd7c-a275-4f50-a227-84937c57c306?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* [Capping themselves with term limits](https://substack.com/redirect/5f112791-24ba-4dc0-ba6f-e6ac15b68985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).9

It doesn't happen immediately, but elected officials _are_ responsive to what voters want, however imperfectly.
And that's the hope I carry with me from Ray's memorial service. Hopeful that there is a way to make things better. Hopeful that there are candidates who still want to run for office to change minds and persuade people. And hopeful that there are people like Ray out there in the world: hard workers, loud critics, and contrarians, truly dedicated to what's right.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTk3MTI5Mjg1LCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzc5ODk2ODgyLCJleHAiOjIwOTU0NzI4ODIsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.iuQ8pm5sQ9qRGCimGWW8mYsohciZuYLfOIskF_1UZtY?)
_**Feel free to share this post with someone who will find this interesting.** If you're reading this email because someone sent it to you, [please consider subscribing](https://substack.com/redirect/18e8f6c1-f1f7-4671-8e64-2957af9ec7b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)._
1
Ann Wagner, Ray would want me to say, is about as flavorful as mayonnaise. And she still hasn't bothered to [update her campaign website from 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/22d91d72-26f4-4f00-85e1-649ade7f5429?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which tells you how unseriously she's taking this next election.
2
Which is now, after having been sold again, a content farm for OnlyFans. So if you want to find the Hottest Lithuanians on OnlyFans in 2026, the _Riverfront Times_ has you covered. (I'm not going to link to this, but I promise you that's a real page on their website. Look it up if you must; the page itself is SFW.)
3
Ray's mom and uncle, who also relocated to Missouri in the mid-'30s, were part of a cohort that later became known as the [One Thousand Children](https://substack.com/redirect/74f86c1e-7211-461a-bbc7-4d2d98b9e3d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
4
You see that with people like U.S. Senator [John Cornyn](https://substack.com/redirect/5dfb50bf-8509-4097-b50f-175e34bedce0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), who [badly lost in his Republican primary](https://substack.com/redirect/97bfdd56-ce2a-4d96-a764-c93adf641faa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last night. He used the valuable time and resources of his office to [write legislation that would name a highway after Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/4f77becb-e336-49fc-aafc-c2db4cc16d2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), purely for the purposes of getting an endorsement he didn't get, purely so he'd win an election he didn't win.
Talk about squandering a chance to truly serve the public.
5
A whole bunch to explain here. Structurally, I used either the [current Cook Political Report](https://substack.com/redirect/633f3f8b-a187-40d7-ad01-1b0beb08fced?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or the [April 2025 vintage of the Cook Political Report](https://substack.com/redirect/9ae051ec-dc5b-43a5-a392-27e8c8dc6da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to determine what constitutes a swing seat. In both, I'm counting swing districts as anything that Cook says is either "Toss Up," "Lean D," or "Lean R."
The result of that is that this chart overstates the count of Democratic gains. A lot of the seats that have recently been redrawn/gerrymandered are right at the cusp of a safe Republican seat and a competitive-but-Republican-leaning seat--there are a few examples of that in Florida, North Carolina, Ohio, and Texas. Moreover, these seats might only be competitive in a year that's shaping up to be bad for Republicans; in other years, they might not be swing seats at all.
Anyway, this chart is--at best--an informed estimate, not science. The real numbers will vary considerably. The other dynamic at play is that while Democrats will try to gerrymander the states they control--New York, New Jersey, Washington, etc.--it'll take a lot more doing than in Republican states, where the legislatures and governors can more or less do it themselves.
A bunch of other notes on individual states:
* _Alabama_ : Despite the [news I shared at the top of the article](https://substack.com/redirect/e24fbaf1-069b-47f5-85c5-2809e42bc348?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), my guess is that Alabama will eventually succeed in further gerrymandering its Congressional map, though that may not happen until the '28 cycle.
* _Colorado_ : It would require [the voters to approve a change](https://substack.com/redirect/aa48373d-bf3c-4772-af23-280af1d4124c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the state's redistricting commission, but that feels possible if not likely at this point.
* _Florida_ : Their gerrymander seems [plainly unconstitutional by the state's prohibition on overtly partisan redistricting](https://substack.com/redirect/1458ce2e-994f-4be6-8c8d-6127a25afbbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but I sincerely doubt the courts will intervene. [Early indications certainly suggest](https://substack.com/redirect/b1954848-a28e-4eea-bcf8-847efd4b89b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that they won't.
* _Georgia_ : They're taking steps to [redraw their maps ahead of 2028](https://substack.com/redirect/f63c76ab-1b0d-491f-87d3-bb4ae8e53128?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Even if [Keisha Lance Bottoms](https://substack.com/redirect/a19f05b6-f90e-4228-8c05-986db3d7c7eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) wins the gubernatorial election this fall, I don't think Democrats will be able to do much to stop this.
* _Indiana_ : State Republicans stood up to the Trump administration earlier this year, and it [cost a bunch of them their jobs](https://substack.com/redirect/429fee40-8cbf-427f-9cfa-fa9d6c8c49e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Will they have a spine when they try again in a year or two? I doubt it.
* _Minnesota_ : It'd require Democrats to [win the State House](https://substack.com/redirect/95bd6a5a-cf07-454b-9a9d-a7eabfd54020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [retain the Senate](https://substack.com/redirect/a3a80d79-a8ff-4dcb-98a5-d28643a35a4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but I think given the way the year is shaping up, that's a pretty good bet.
* _Missouri_ : Thanks to Denny Hoskins--[an all-around weird guy](https://substack.com/redirect/f4c9e64e-9e4a-4ab7-99c1-d9925f62a735?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to say nothing of the fact that he plainly doesn't do his job--who knows if the citizen-initiated repeal of the state's gerrymander will even end up on the ballot. If it succeeds, I wonder whether the state legislature will turn around and just do the same thing in '27\. Feels like an endless game of cat-and-mouse.
* _Utah_ : My guess is that, one way or another, state Republicans find a way to win the fourth seat back.
* _Virginia_ : Same deal: my guess is that Democrats find a way to carve up Virginia.
* _Wisconsin_ : Who knows, but with [greater control of the courts](https://substack.com/redirect/23d9517d-0607-4145-ba88-af26203a3aaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and an [outside chance to flip the legislature](https://substack.com/redirect/c610b3a0-4cc5-4c88-8b63-c40339ed3372?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Democrats could very well pick up a few seats there.

6
Bear with me on the math here. When I say structurally possible, what I mean is that states that have one Congressional seat can't gerrymander themselves (there's nothing to gerrymander) and states with two Congressional seats have a much trickier time doing it (there's only one other district to displace voters).
That's a bit of an oversimplification, I'll note. In New Hampshire, it'd be possible to draw one Republican-leaning district and one very Democratic district, rather than two slightly Democratic districts. In Maine, you could take one very Democratic district and put some of its voters into the state's Republican-leaning [2nd District](https://substack.com/redirect/34177444-2653-4153-bcab-96aefd096477?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to make it more competitive. But it's a lot trickier and riskier.
So I removed 13 states in all that have one or two Congressional districts: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Idaho, Maine, Montana, New Hampshire, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Vermont, West Virginia, and Wyoming.
To get to 25 states (rather than the 23 on this chart), I'm including two others: [Kentucky and Kansas](https://substack.com/redirect/e3db951a-273e-4fa2-8b0b-d36458e8e4e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). If both states pick up Republican governors, which is quite possible, I think both will try to redraw their lines. It was too big an "if" to include them in the chart above but it's certainly possible.
That's how we get to 25 ÷ 37 = 68%.
7
Of course, even these victories weren't without hurdles. African-Americans technically had the right to vote since the [Fifteenth Amendment](https://substack.com/redirect/79305021-e650-4d41-9948-a190751c3a31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but in many states, they didn't have the right in practice. And of course, states still put up barriers for Native Americans and African-Americans to vote.
8
And this is before you get into true policy successes. For example: over the last 60 years, we've [cut the smoking rate in this country by about 75%](https://substack.com/redirect/082b3ac1-44a3-4e33-91dd-23c267c603e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite the best efforts of the tobacco industry, [saving eight million lives](https://substack.com/redirect/710620ac-b342-4fd5-bca0-5fab2b5c09fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from lung cancer and other related diseases, and extending tens of millions more.
9
At least in Louisiana. In other states, term limits were implemented by citizen-initiated ballot measures.

body:
✍️ Help us meet our goal of delivering 30,000 letters to Congress | | | Peter, June 15 will mark 14 years of DACA, yet the future of hundreds of thousands of our neighbors has never felt more uncertain. Close to 340 DACA recipients have been detained in the last year. Nearly 90 of them have been deported and torn from their families and communities. Thousands more are losing their jobs, healthcare, and driver’s licenses everyday due to prolonged renewal delays. **Sandra is a DACA recipient who has been waiting for her DACA renewal since November 2025.** In January, her work authorization and protections lapsed, leading her to be suspended from her job. As a single mother of four, she is her family’s sole provider. **Her children’s father was deported last May, and now, prolonged DACA renewal delays are putting her family at risk once more.** Peter, whether it’s prolonged delays, challenges in court, or the increasing threat of deportation, the DACA program is being dismantled before our eyes. DACA’s slow death is making it impossible for our neighbors to plan for their future and for our communities to thrive. Without a pathway to citizenship in place, families like Sandra’s will continue to see their safety and future at stake. And, millions of working people who rely on DACA recipients, as our teachers, nurses, neighbors, will pay the price too. **✍️** Now is our time to unite and urge our members of Congress to pave a pathway to citizenship that will protect the lives of working people. [**Will you join thousands of us in taking action to call on Congress to support the Dream Act?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhyzCKAdQv6ANAIbZ_2K5v_dADgIQbtoYRtlyHXs5n-56nnFNcywkWWncf6lmAwsm9eEMA2Xp-mmr6aqO9ZNcI-3VB-SyckH9t9RoPuJhQkVix839MlU929d2HOEXURNSbt2yiOXBuhhDk8lfAZGZa8-n1QbwDJQfEl3d68cNjdadf2pkKv69W164x6lQD7lw9Bv4_O6-nsW_h4hKpXO1NNdkdjjRm4Rz95JHlJpgUdCCVUe7YDJVWUyxWBtZzUtkcjmPmKsbsyJZWxJjyay51g41x0yAlwvYUnOxNK40EqZUdN3TPx7lG29ni8IElOGJjaSgZufpVf97465IGfP7Z3GsxIn8H6SF8jPwFzG_ur6M8M0d4yO4IjD1XJemj4JGDtg/4qz/1vMnP4W1Qv22ZHF7kPQuYw/h0/h001.d2ENIsyqLk6wkKFgl-D5jTTZ5MvQn25ZOR2ThxvQ3VY) **[👉 Send Your Letter 👈](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhyzCKAdQv6ANAIbZ_2K5v_dADgIQbtoYRtlyHXs5n-56nnFNcywkWWncf6lmAwsm9eEMA2Xp-mmr6aqO9ZNcI-3VB-SyckH9t9RoPuJhQkVix839MlU929d2HOEXURNSbt2yiOXBuhhDk8lfAZGZa8-nax9edAPVB25Cl2r3FwX8Gx7FM122vnonVrtoIqzCPHg1Q2kAfOhpDWguX2G1caVa8qtM3LiPdTGyzhgZ5V0fV8UDRbCkWqjBrUOcb_aziNGj8Wv6mtYmaQMqagXNhuSuizUPWm84cdLQbucUc9jfV_O4VW9BFxFsS-uDeoYc-pa21pbPs8oK41y8CKjgsFMb6FHj3-syLEs4VmYPTJ0TyaMaPGqwwqP8h_Y2tBZxOgA/4qz/1vMnP4W1Qv22ZHF7kPQuYw/h1/h001.lluCgv8IkPVxOsITsB0hy--UDvqsMYZbMQgtam5vPbA)[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhyzCKAdQv6ANAIbZ_2K5v_dADgIQbtoYRtlyHXs5n-56nnFNcywkWWncf6lmAwsm9eEMA2Xp-mmr6aqO9ZNcI-3VB-SyckH9t9RoPuJhQkVix839MlU929d2HOEXURNSbt2yiOXBuhhDk8lfAZGZa8-lvsMtPiELI3Lc4hZMLBbPb0pZskD2p7OOuPJhSQ_7NsYgJYEqJIrPqFG8QmmpXHB6O6cvDDWn2n9SOqWpJ3ohU-to3BJSL3ID6hSx_jkMJX6rU_yEBL7RGeZ3tcH2uYYxzJMBuef4hnpvydQMn_lkvRwRELsJBeolV_dHzoZoiqhNd-LE8I4alVT_Qkk0e9-aRO6Rp4AEHg0GJttzvdws59ehxnkgjQrwyrpYQy-3Srg/4qz/1vMnP4W1Qv22ZHF7kPQuYw/h2/h001.aMaW-PRAaupQ4GajvrHmKRbMUfHkRZ6sLq0XN9EyO8s)** **We face the most dangerous moment in DACA’s history, but our power has never been stronger.** Right now, most working families — immigrant or not — are already struggling to make ends meet. Most of us are able to relate to the feeling of not knowing if we’ll be able to afford the rising costs of groceries, rent, and healthcare. clean_body: ✍️ Help us meet our goal of delivering 30,000 letters to Congress | | | Peter, June 15 will mark 14 years of DACA, yet the future of hundreds of thousands of our neighbors has never felt more uncertain. Close to 340 DACA recipients have been detained in the last year. Nearly 90 of them have been deported and torn from their families and communities. Thousands more are losing their jobs, healthcare, and driver’s licenses everyday due to prolonged renewal delays. Sandra is a DACA recipient who has been waiting for her DACA renewal since November 2025. In January, her work authorization and protections lapsed, leading her to be suspended from her job. As a single mother of four, she is her family’s sole provider. Her children’s father was deported last May, and now, prolonged DACA renewal delays are putting her family at risk once more. Peter, whether it’s prolonged delays, challenges in court, or the increasing threat of deportation, the DACA program is being dismantled before our eyes. DACA’s slow death is making it impossible for our neighbors to plan for their future and for our communities to thrive. Without a pathway to citizenship in place, families like Sandra’s will continue to see their safety and future at stake. And, millions of working people who rely on DACA recipients, as our teachers, nurses, neighbors, will pay the price too. ✍️ Now is our time to unite and urge our members of Congress to pave a pathway to citizenship that will protect the lives of working people. We face the most dangerous moment in DACA’s history, but our power has never been stronger. Right now, most working families — immigrant or not — are already struggling to make ends meet. Most of us are able to relate to the feeling of not knowing if we’ll be able to afford the rising costs of groceries, rent, and healthcare. We’re calling for a pathway to citizenship because we know it’s the key to keeping our families, workforce, and communities intact. After our Community Call last week, our neighbors have already volunteered to host over 50 letter-writing gatherings around the country, and they’ll be delivering their handwritten letters to their members of Congress on June 15. The more of us who take action, the harder it will be for Congress to ignore our demands. ✊ In power, Nico and the UWD team P.S.: Want to take your power to the next level? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132171364/623630638/846650056?refcode=em-5.27.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjNkYjliYS1lMzU5LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qtUKIDp2lVKvN37g3jKio0ZoF6mBahHA6RBDQ6aprb8=) Friend, One thing I’ve seen while traveling the country is that most Americans aren’t asking for miracles from Washington. They just want to know somebody is focused on getting results that improve their everyday lives. Americans are asking: Can I afford groceries this week? Is my paycheck keeping up? Will my kids have opportunities where we live? Does anybody in Congress actually understand what families are dealing with? Too often, people feel like the answer is no. That’s part of why I’m glad Kristen McDonald Rivet is stepping up to change things. Kristen brings something to Washington that can be hard to find these days: a grounded understanding of how policy decisions affect people’s everyday lives. As a mom of six representing one of the toughest swing districts in the country, she approaches the job with a sense of urgency, practicality, and common sense. She’s focused on the kinds of things that matter enormously to families across Michigan and the nation – lowering costs, strengthening public schools, supporting workers, and making government work a little better for ordinary people. And she’s already showing what that looks like in Congress. Just a few weeks ago, Kristen helped pass legislation allowing families to use SNAP benefits to buy hot rotisserie chickens – fixing a rule that made no sense to working parents trying to get an affordable meal on the table after a long day. That may sound small to some people in Washington. But when a working mom needs to put food on the table at the end of a long day, it matters to her. And it says something important about the kind of representative Kristen is. This year, Kristen’s district, MI-08, is once again one of the most competitive races in the country. Keeping leaders like Kristen in Congress, and in doing so, flipping the House, will matter not just for Michigan families, but for the direction of the country as a whole. clean_body: | = Friend, One thing I’ve seen while traveling the country is that most Americans aren’t asking for miracles from Washington. They just want to know somebody is focused on getting results that improve their everyday lives. Americans are asking: Can I afford groceries this week? Is my paycheck keeping up? Will my kids have opportunities where we live? Does anybody in Congress actually understand what families are dealing with? Too often, people feel like the answer is no. That’s part of why I’m glad Kristen McDonald Rivet is stepping up to change things. Kristen brings something to Washington that can be hard to find these days: a grounded understanding of how policy decisions affect people’s everyday lives. As a mom of six representing one of the toughest swing districts in the country, she approaches the job with a sense of urgency, practicality, and common sense. She’s focused on the kinds of things that matter enormously to families across Michigan and the nation – lowering costs, strengthening public schools, supporting workers, and making government work a little better for ordinary people. And she’s already showing what that looks like in Congress. Just a few weeks ago, Kristen helped pass legislation allowing families to use SNAP benefits to buy hot rotisserie chickens – fixing a rule that made no sense to working parents trying to get an affordable meal on the table after a long day. That may sound small to some people in Washington. But when a working mom needs to put food on the table at the end of a long day, it matters to her. And it says something important about the kind of representative Kristen is. This year, Kristen’s district, MI-08, is once again one of the most competitive races in the country. #
**BREAKING: Ken Paxton is the Republican nominee for the Texas U.S. Senate Race and will be facing James Talarico this November.**
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260527-1-ak.e55f59&amount=3&refcode=em20260527-180&t=1&akid=180%2E1366028%2Eu_FA5l)Paxton is hand-selected by Trump, and National Republicans are about to flood Texas with money, lies, and fear to stop James Talarico and keep this seat red in November.
[**If we want to fight back and flip Texas, we have to start right now. Will you chip in $3 today to help Voto Latino register and mobilize Latino voters in Texas between now and November?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260527-1-ak.e55f59&amount=3&refcode=em20260527-180&t=2&akid=180%2E1366028%2Eu_FA5l)
**_Paxton is bad news, Peter._** He’s spent his career using power to target Latinos — the very communities that make Texas run.
→ **He undermined voting rights** by going after non-profits and voter registration groups, and blocked counties from sending out mail-in ballots in 2020 to rig election outcomes.
→ Attacked health care access by leading the charge to tear down the Affordable Care Act, **a move that aimed to rip health care coverage from up to 1.9 million Texans.**
→ Worked to dismantle reproductive freedoms for millions of Texans, and after Texas clinics shut down, **2.9 million Latina women lost access to basic health services.**
→ **His own party has voted to impeach him on 20 charges, including bribery, abuse of office, and obstruction of justice.** He’s also faced three felony securities fraud charges that could have sent him to prison for decades, but he faced absolutely no consequences.
→**He’s targeted immigrant families for years,** including leading court fights against DACA and moving to end in-state tuition for undocumented students.
Ken Paxton is as corrupt as it comes, but Texas can reject him at the ballot box this November. Latino voters are a decisive force in this state. Six and a half million Latinos are eligible to vote in the Lone Star State. Two million aren't registered. Last cycle, over half were never contacted by anyone. Voto Latino can close the registration gap and mobilize voters, and help secure victories up and down the ballot.
We need your support today. We’re working around the clock now until November in Texas — registering eligible voters, letting them know what’s at stake, fighting disinformation, and turning registration into turnout.

clean_body: The worst of the worst | = Peter, MAGA Republicans across the country should be worried. They’re selling out hardworking people to do Trump’s bidding. They’re running on costly, out-of-touch records. And across the country, EMILYs List women are running to make sure they can’t keep getting away with it. So we’re making sure they hear us loud and clear: Their days in office are numbered. Today, we're launching our end-of-month On Notice goal to raise $200,000 and help defeat the 100 Republicans facing EMILYs List women this November. From statehouses to the U.S. House and Senate, we’re holding Republicans accountable for backing abortion bans, selling out working families, and handing giveaways to big corporations – and supporting the Democratic pro-choice women ready to defeat them. = | = We’re putting Republicans at every level of government on notice. Here are just a few of MAGA’s worst offenders: Vivek Ramaswamy (OH-GOV): The Republican nominee for governor of Ohio, who has called Medicaid “a mistake,” is as out-of-touch as they come. One of the original faces of Trump’s “DOGE” agenda, Ramaswamy has made clear that his priority is slashing the programs and protections families count on — not lowering costs or making life easier for Ohioans. Sen. Lindsey Graham (SC-SEN): After more than three decades in Congress, Lindsey Graham has built a long record of anti-choice, anti-worker votes. He’s a spineless Trump acolyte who has introduced multiple federal abortion bans, backed efforts to repeal the Affordable Care Act, and supported legislation to gut healthcare and food assistance for South Carolinians. Rep. Rob Bresnahan (PA-08): Instead of focusing on lowering costs for Pennsylvanians, Rob Bresnahan has been busy looking out for his own bottom line. Bresnahan ran on the promise to ban congressional stock trades, but since taking office last year he’s already made over 600 trades. Patriot,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**

[ ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=f8b8b59386c34557816867d0c8beeaa9&_e=cNuSVZLQQUUyqgpPu-BozQl0vsVpiKJzrUb4--xqGgtS3K02kEHgyj1qxz_0bXzSE3dYxtMHeflT4CBDb3rbXwU3yHcGwZ00TGDUux7xymOi93BHsDJx6ed5_iOJw54g0oyR0DpEJXJkkKDPT8ZJsdXLaaqabHYUhyBROZ4L_K0WfW16Dp-NNQOoCv5_xh2ZBvl8HiedRjwFZyEE3aH4-zLziv-1bUqcJOdmhTIVshIDSYlpWtOSZjxtn_AIwnO-yrt4tXXj_5OkQbGvuGuGgHc5phNSzu5F5ozpm94FLMKcYqjnei348F-KetXbzsRjPOSKWBe-5a_jf-yXdWxHkGPa1Nho0IrbUnsfvBoS6npsko3FFXMK6OAnEX5dtcLuO-znynkxjOt0QIWteafArc8oyDrfYuu9P4IJN-i6_k2OkcX_hFmwheqR1cFa6uLw3cxDa0Qq6TAWuVnYCOtwqN30CZ2IReVV0dE8Y3NKVzv1mqz4KZ3zR3iLm5DVWruqHYfyfxvGkqPms-fINDYpWgAIl7oONv9HeOOW7e2f1GMbWFEzEw47T3L1iSp3ZmI-xIUDuN-DuraZR8oteId1dYA3ZhXeZyIPPuwbAbo6PDh8FGU1ggRCl4WFx4hEzRPUAH3mQC_k5lrDDFE8MBpLzPsqt6MCG5f4MYVKfROoNEm9m3EXEejaL7oAPf4ajLHD8YF-HjQvjwXhKxKDvrYSFjX-CNA1GTNO_db86LPyeJXjzwHiM4OZS6MAsvq0UszLTiEkMCQOEW2_OQ1XYadDg2S5tAp3YYK3YwHVk3nkvzY%3D)

**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. **As we approach Memorial Day, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall** – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. **For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose.** For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates.
**While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there.** Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home.

clean_body: For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics. | | | | | | Patriot, In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California. A 12-year-old girl. Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge. Our operators physically extracted her. What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been. And underneath all of it, faith. Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started. That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive. Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team. She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – the next child is already missing. This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot. In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed: ✅ Eight American families extracted from Mexico in February. ✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March. ✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti. ✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas this January. The work goes back further. 64 evacuated from Ukraine during active combat in 2022. 58 Christians rescued from persecution across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum. For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas. The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism. Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts. Total goal: $1,000,000 by October. First milestone: $100,000. | "MAKE A GIFT TODAY" As we approach Memorial Day, I would be remiss to not highlight a central piece of the facility, our Foundational Wall – our way of honoring those who've served, and other heroes among us who deserve our gratitude. For gifts of $1,000 or more, you can dedicate a brick in honor of someone you choose. For service members, information will include name, unit, branch, birth and end dates. For non-service members, information may include personal details and attributes, “in loving memory of,” and birth and end dates. While that 12-year-old girl in California is now safe, countless other missing children are already out there. Please, help us build the place that prepares our operators to go find, and bring them home. Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – to free the oppressed, so others may live. Respectfully submitted, Dennis Price Founder & CEO Heroes for Humanity | | | | "PLEASE DONATE" | | | | | SERVING THE VULNERABLE. SHARING THE GOSPEL. body:
A humbling message...
| Peter,
---
I’m truly humbled and honored.
---
Direct from the White House, my friend President Trump said:
---
**“JIM JORDAN IS A VERY GOOD FRIEND, FIGHTER, AND WINNER... HE WILL _NEVER_ LET YOU DOWN”**
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d064350711064e05896c36c5e61bea95&_e=gkmb9Br-0LflgyZ_JjtBfKGXkLVxAwirQs6L-PJunBmzaBXem3ySvnlPZ8xT89pogHZEGO0ZZzTUJDCgCqFSHCHQ1cDDrZ-ttyPGRE_sRdU4wSoabRdC5QrgNlgK_QxvHZVNLtTRThRDZ3O27DIzSwoUyT4WW7LM1t7baQ7-eYrgyIPxwi1-lKKzQHs6JbXN792ewnHPXLZufzzu3ybEJxZ28ddNpnj-cykwHISiH5qfMj615j2KwjP8OpeYQDL_4y-1imSYGXIpwDeHp3xb5Arge6QMgC1km_fr9khmrN4QNn6g-4E-42XkbkJFUvNmnEnpHYNa839FHwu0m7oQtDzuFkDmbEtq2xOerXHiel_dOfG7wT8bWvSKHgg9Gve6p6wFeVfXup0TOO7frKrmEyjbnw_qN_vcJfVvEtzmzWDaEN-ftlx4wOxAE-iFTQf-2n9DQAWItaouEfSVryRcklrOpePicnf3QMJ3pB_hTkgTRFSgr_1uauKckN-kYBtJo38gzCFHWVwOzUahpUymaIWmagKvb4NocnwFVaodycc92yIJ5xezpFBUoBH3ckFJ769cdi5BcV3VH32haCXbrg%3D%3D)
---
Coming from the President, those are powerful words.
---
President Trump knows _better than anyone_ the fight I’m waging to drain the swamp and put power back where it belongs – with _YOU_ , the American people.
---
Look, I know talk is cheap in politics. Anyone can make a promise. Anyone can say they’ll fight.
---
**But I’ve got the receipts to back it up**. I’ve been sued. I’ve been spied on. My phone records were seized. And the Left only attacks me, because I fight for YOU.
---
**I’m working with the President – _behind the scenes and all hours of the day_ – to deliver on the agenda you voted for.**
---
And directly from the Oval Office, President Trump laid out the agenda **WE** are fighting for:
---
_**✅Grow our economy
✅Cut taxes
✅Slash burdensome regulations
✅Promote Made-In-The-USA products
✅Champion American energy dominance
✅Keep our border secure
✅Stop migrant crime
✅Defend your constitutional rights
✅Stopping the Radical Left ** _
---
And in just a few months, that same agenda will be voted on AGAIN in the midterm elections.
---
There’s been a lot of doom and gloom about our odds of holding the House. But truth be told, Democrats now ONLY have a **2-POINT** advantage over us.
---
And that’s not because voters suddenly approve of Radical Left ideas._It’s simply because our side isn’t showing up to vote._
---
**If 2% more Republicans show up, we can EASILY erase the Democrats’ 2-point lead. This is a problem we can absolutely fix.**
---
_So, we are going zip code by zip code in our voter file to determine where we need more participation._
---
Peter, we’ve crunched the numbers and with our razor-thin majority now within the margin of error, YOUR voter profile in your zip code is the difference maker.
---
_That’s why I’m reaching out today to simply ask that you VERIFY your GOP voter profile to give me and President Trump the most accurate polling possible to ERASE the Democrats’ 2% LEAD over us._
---
