body:
Today Ed Hale promised he would raise tolls if elected, and refused to support the GOP nominee against Wes Moore. | | | |
---
| | |
# "You have to raise the tolls high enough" to pay for our bridge construction. - Ed Hale, Sean & Co., WCBM, 5/27/2026
---
|
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/bLnN7h0VJQe?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)
---
| [Donate Now to Help Dan Win](https://us.list-manage.com/10ibRTzsRkw?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b "Donate Now to Help Dan Win")
---
| Dear Dan Cox for Governor,

Yes, he really said it out loud. Ed Hale [today](https://us.list-manage.com/9Ikm3tNP9wX?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) promised to raise tolls in Maryland "to pay for our bridges" after Governor Larry Hogan lowered them.

And then he disrespected the entire Republican party by claiming that the "others" running are "ridiculous." No matter whether one should vote for them or not, it is elitist to claim that Republican candidates who didn't change from Democrat nearly yesterday like Ed Hale are "ridiculous." Ed Hale should be more respectful of our Party.
_Sean: "If you do not win on June 23, will you support the GOP nominee against Wes Moore?

Ed Hale: "No. I will not support either one of these two [GOP] people running against me."

Sean: "but I believe there are like nine running..."

Ed Hale: "yeah but the others are ridiculous."_
But that is not all: _Hale announced he will NOT debate his Republican opponents and that he will NOT support whoever the Republican nominee is against Wes Moore_. He further failed to answer the question how he will unify and build the Republican Party if he wins, as he would be the head of the Party. Instead, he referenced merely that he is getting some elected GOP endorsements but stated no plan and no vision to help build a future for fixing our gerrymandered state, expanding opportunities for ownership and lower costs, and reducing big government.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/17R3UVOd1HE?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)

And he didn't stop there. He refused to directly promise to repeal the bloated Kirwan education budget (while he failed to remember the common name "Blueprint for Maryland's Future").

Here is the real kicker for most parents as well: when Sean asked him directly if he as governor would support overturning the regulations preventing parents from knowing their child's gender identity change discussions happening behind their backs and order schools to tell parents, he actually gave a confusing answer and should clarify.

_Sean: "a policy of the Maryland State Department of Education [regarding transgender direction], as governor you would lead the charge here. As governor are you in favor of instructing the Maryland Department of Education to remove this part of the curriculum, instructions and direction - should parents be told when their children identify as another gender?"

Ed Hale: "[laughing] you know what the answer is to that one [laughing], it's so weird it's indescribably weird, No, I want the state out, let parents parent."_

What does that mean? It means it seems that Hale will NOT seek to overturn the policy of hiding the information from parents because he doesn't want teachers involved in telling parents what is going on with their child. That is dangerous to the child and prevents their best support - the parents - from knowing serious information necessary for the care, custody and upbringing of their child.

It is no secret that Ed Hale's money empowered the Governorship of O'Malley who transgendered our children and state with SB 212 (2014) "Fairness for All Marylanders Act" which began the process of allowing regulations in education stripping parents of their parental rights to know the information about their own child.

**Immediately after the interview, trending markets such as Polymarket indicated a 70%_drop_ in support for Ed Hale to win the GOP nomination, and Dan Cox for the first time reached 80%**.

Maryland Republicans are aware that any Democrat in Republican's clothing means MOORE of the same this fall if we don't nominate a real Republican. I am that Republican and I can not only win but unify and build the Party.

I am on record with my common sense plan to restore Maryland.
* Lower fees and taxes including property taxes and senior retirement taxes;
* ending VEIP (emissions) fees;
* slash car registration fees;
* cut in half utility and electric bills by suspending the green fake deal tax of 30% and bring back online the power plants presently suspended while bringing more online fast (including SMRs and LNG plants);
* suspend the gas tax;
* suspend regulatory opposition to construction of new homes and create affordable housing, install both a statewide inspector general and inspector generals over each department and audit them and reduce those departments;
* repeal Kirwan and ensure the education dollars follows the student to the classroom, appoint parental-rights and school choice advocates to the Accountability board and Board of Education;
* ensure NO MORE boys in girls sports, ORDER the state BOE to rescind its policy preventing the informing parents of their child's gender discussions and requiring schools to not hide it from them, and banning boys from entering girls locker rooms and bathrooms.

But I am writing to let you know that we need funding to reach 100,000 voters by June 23 and to launch us firmly into the general election to beat Wes Moore.

We have had over 10 million views on social media, including over 1.5 million in only the last eight days. But we need to reach each Maryland voter at least three times to gain their support over Wes Moore.

Will you donate today [$100, $250, $500, or any amount](https://us.list-manage.com/QaJV0hUPDVL?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)? We need freedom sponsors of [$1000 each to launch our radio ads](https://us.list-manage.com/Nu3CrV2bp92?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b). We need constitutional sponsors of [$500 each to launch our mailers](https://us.list-manage.com/11MUjTNKHbg?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b). We need donations of $100 or any amount to keep fighting on social media and by getting our signs out to supporters.

I humbly ask for your vote and your involvement - including your urgent donation - to help us win for Maryland.

Cheers for Freedom,

Authority: Dan Cox for Governor; Nick Krop, CPA, Treasurer

While Congress debates tax cuts for the wealthiest Americans, school budgets are being slashed. While pharmaceutical companies post record profits, families are rationing insulin. Seth knows that you can be both, because the two are not at odds with one another. He has been one of the earliest supporters of the Green New Deal in Congress, is a member of the Climate Solutions Caucus, and is a champion for clean energy investment in Massachusetts. Seth supports an investment of $20 million in clean school bus funding, and an addition of millions more for clean energy manufacturing right here in the state. As early as 2016, Seth pushed for 50% clean electricity by 2030, before most people in Washington were taking it seriously. And most recently, Seth is a cosponsor of the Energy Bills Relief Act. clean_body: | | Friend, There's a false choice juxtaposed in climate politics: that you're either fighting for the planet or you are fighting to keep costs down for working families. Seth knows that you can be both, because the two are not at odds with one another. He has been one of the earliest supporters of the Green New Deal in Congress, is a member of the Climate Solutions Caucus, and is a champion for clean energy investment in Massachusetts. Seth supports an investment of $20 million in clean school bus funding, and an addition of millions more for clean energy manufacturing right here in the state. As early as 2016, Seth pushed for 50% clean electricity by 2030, before most people in Washington were taking it seriously. And most recently, Seth is a cosponsor of the Energy Bills Relief Act. And Seth’s ambitious plan for New England Crossrail would take over 90 million cars off the road every year. This is a great example of policy that won’t just benefit the climate, but will also lower energy costs, decrease time stuck in traffic, and provide real economic opportunity for Massachusetts families. Done right, the clean energy transition doesn't have to cost working people more — it should cost them less. = | = = The stakes are too high to wait. — Moulton HQ | | | ---|---|--- About Seth Moulton Seth Moulton is a Marine and a Democrat with a mission to bring a new generation of leaders to Congress. name: Keisha Lance Bottoms
subject: An election denier could be Governor of Georgia
body:
I’m writing to ask for $3 to help me stop Republicans from putting a 2020 election denier in Georgia's governor's mansion -- where he could refuse to certify any Democratic win in the state.
No, that’s not a typo.
**Georgia’s Lieutenant Governor Burt Jones was one of the 16 fake electors who signed a false certificate claiming Donald Trump won Georgia in 2020. A certificate that was sent to Congress to try to block the certification of Joe Biden’s win.**
Now he wants to be Governor of Georgia, where he would be responsible for certifying our state's 2028 presidential election results.
I’m Keisha Lance Bottoms, the Democrat running to stop him.

subject: Tell Congress: Hands Off Grand Staircase-Escalante!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM3NDI3MjUS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ2MDY4ODY3OAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Hands Off Grand Staircase-Escalante!

Trump’s Republican allies in Congress are trying to gut protections for Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument in Utah. The environmental movement must speak up loud and clear: hands off our public lands!

LCV is calling on Congress to reject this legislative attack. We must keep up
public pressure to maintain protections for Grand Staircase-Escalante National
Monument and all our treasured public lands.

Tell Congress: Protect Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monumen https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Zzb0Mq7-~ ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, The same Republicans who have long wanted to sell off our public lands are back
at it — this time they’ve introduced legislation to gut protections for Grand
Staircase-Escalante National Monument in southern Utah. This legislation, introduced by Sen. Mike Lee and Rep. Celeste Maloy, is an
unprecedented attempt to overturn a national monument’s management plan to open
up these treasured places to more extraction, serving corporate interests. If it
succeeds, this maneuver could become part of the MAGA playbook for dismantling
protections for even more of our culturally rich national monuments and
treasured public lands. We can’t let this happen. Tell Congress: Protect Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument! https://links.messages.lcv. Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument spans nearly 1.9 million acres of
canyons, ancient fossil beds, sacred cultural sites, and essential wildlife
habitat. It’s home to bighorn sheep, mule deer, and endangered and protected
species like the California condor and bald eagle. Overturning the management
plan puts all this, and more, at risk. Current protections reflect years of scientific research, public comment, and
collaboration with Tribal coalitions and local communities. If enacted, this
legislation would strip critical protections away — and the consequences could
extend far beyond Utah and this monument. We need to make sure this doesn’t become the blueprint for dismantling national
monuments across the country. Don’t wait — send your message to Congress now. https://links.messages.lcv. Speak up with LCV today and help keep our public lands protected for future
generations. Thank you for taking action for people and our planet. America Fitzpatrick
Conservation Program Director
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. I’m the Democratic Nominee

| Folks,

**It’s official: I am the Democratic nominee for Texas’s 35th Congressional District.**

It’s up to us to break Greg Abbott’s gerrymander this November and show that South Texas will fight back against anyone who wants to rig our maps and steal our democracy.

I was born and raised on the West Side of San Antonio by my mother, who taught me the value of hard work and the strength of working families. I then went on to serve in Bexar County as a deputy, SWAT hostage negotiator, and as a Public Information Officer for Sheriff Javier Salazar.

**That's what service looks like — not the political theater Texas Republicans play in Washington.**

I’m an old-school Democrat fighting to give working families a voice in our government — for people like my mom, fellow deputies on patrol, and their children too. I believe everyone should be rewarded for hard work, health care should be affordable, and our communities should be safe and secure.

name: David Hogg
subject: About my California trip
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Can I have a moment of your time to tell you about my trip to see our candidates in California?
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260527-2&t=1&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)
Peter,
I traveled to California a couple weeks ago to spend time on the ground with our endorsed candidates, and I came back with something I haven’t felt in a while: real hope.
I spent time in the Central Valley with **Randy Villegas** and a crew of student volunteers that are absolutely fired up about his campaign and the future he’s fighting for. I was particularly inspired by one of the students who said he didn't vote in the last election because he felt so hopeless and let down by corrupt politicians. He is now not only voting for Randy, but he’s actively campaigning for him because he finally has hope that he’ll be represented. That student is _exactly_ why we do what we do at Leaders We Deserve — because there are millions more people like him who want to believe deep down that democracy can work, but they’ve lost so much hope and trust in our party that they don’t even bother voting.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&refcode=em20260527-3529&t=2&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)
**Randy is exactly the kind of leader we desperately need more of right now: grounded, unapologetically progressive, and willing to fight like hell for the people who have been ignored by the establishment for way too long.**
That’s why they’re terrified of Randy’s momentum. It’s why the DCCC is propping up a conservative Democrat, Jasmeet Bains, instead of Randy even though he’s the stronger candidate. And it’s why corporate-aligned donors are lining up behind his opponent.
**[The contrast couldn’t be clearer — Randy is exactly the kind of leader our organization was built to back. Will you pitch in $5 now to help us continue supporting next generation leaders like Randy?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&refcode=em20260527-3529&amount=5&t=3&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&amount=5&refcode=em20260527-3529&t=4&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
Then I headed up to Sacramento to see **Mai Vang**.
Mai and I hosted an event at an Elk Grove bookstore to talk about building the next generation of leadership. The room was absolutely _packed_. They chanted with Mai, “our time, our time” — because that’s exactly what this moment is.
Our time to stop handing leadership to out of touch Democrats who don’t know the first thing about working people’s priorities — and don’t care to. Our time to build a Democratic Party that is accountable to the people, and only the people, not corporations or ultra-rich political insiders. Our time to get off the sidelines and fight for the kind of future we actually want to live in.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&refcode=em20260527-3529&t=5&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)
And Mai gets that.
She understands that we can’t just be a party that tells people what we’re against — we have to offer them something worth believing in, and leaders they’re genuinely excited to vote for.
That’s why she’s taking on Doris Matsui, a multi-millionaire who has spent years insulated from the people she’s supposed to represent. Doris has taken maxed-out checks from AIPAC and piles of corporate money from the defense industry.
Mai is the complete opposite. She’s the leader CA-07 needs right now because she represents something different: the next generation of leadership rooted in courage, community, and people power.
**[Pitch in $5 now to help us back more leaders like Mai.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&refcode=em20260527-3529&amount=5&t=6&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&amount=5&refcode=em20260527-3529&t=7&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
And before I left, I got a chance to meet up with **Lauren Babb Tomlinson** in Sacramento.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&refcode=em20260527-3529&t=8&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)
Lauren is a working mom with a 15 month old at home who has been totally crushing it on the campaign trail. As a leader at Planned Parenthood, Lauren has seen firsthand the horrific cost of Trump’s war on healthcare. Her experience makes her exactly the kind of leader we need in Congress right now. A leader who shows up, does the work, and builds relationships in the community one conversation at a time — because they’ve seen what happens when Democrats sit on the sidelines instead of getting in the fight.
**[Chip in $5 to help us continue backing fearless leaders like Lauren.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&refcode=em20260527-3529&amount=5&t=9&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&amount=5&refcode=em20260527-3529&t=10&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
Spending time with Lauren, Mai, and Randy reminded me exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists in the first place.
These are leaders that are stepping up to the plate because their neighbors needed a fighter in their corner, and they refused to wait around for someone else to do it.
Peter, all three of our candidates’ primaries are on **June 2** — this has already been the biggest year so far in Leaders We Deserve history, and we’re on a winning streak. We can’t afford to slow down.
**[Will you pitch in $5 to help Leaders We Deserve support courageous leaders like Lauren, Mai, and Randy and keep building momentum all the way to November?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&refcode=em20260527-3529&amount=5&t=11&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260527_2_california.bvhLmK&amount=5&refcode=em20260527-3529&t=30&akid=3529%2E587540%2ELgX9xg)**
Thank you,
David Hogg

**By Wendy M. Yurgo**
Tuesday night felt like one of those rare American sports and political nights where momentum wasn't just winning. Momentum was overwhelming.
President Trump's endorsed candidates kept rolling through Republican races with a perfect record once again, reinforcing what much of the political establishment still refuses to admit: the America First movement is not fading. It is consolidating. From Texas to key primary battles across the country, Trump's endorsements continue to carry extraordinary weight inside the Republican Party.
At the very same time, my Vegas Golden Knights were delivering their own statement to the hockey world.
Sweep.
Not a lucky bounce. Not a fluke overtime survival. A sweep.

The Golden Knights dismantled the Colorado Avalanche and punched their ticket to the Stanley Cup Final for the third time in nine seasons.
There is something fascinating about watching two entirely different arenas, politics and sports, suddenly share the exact same energy. Confidence. Discipline. Relentless execution. A movement and a hockey team both operating with the unmistakable force that comes when momentum turns into belief.
Vegas understands this feeling better than most cities.
The hockey world mocked the Golden Knights from the beginning. They were the "expansion team." The outsiders. The team that wasn't supposed to work. Yet somehow they built one of the toughest cultures in hockey and turned Las Vegas into a true sports town almost overnight.
That mirrors what happened politically over the last decade.

That assumption looks weaker by the day. American consumer confidence is at its lowest level in over 11 years, and it's clear why. Growing Inflation has become the new normal. Grocery prices have risen 30% over the last decade.
**[And what once felt like a strong balance in your 401(k) has begun to look too small to survive on in retirement.](https://substack.com/redirect/19804c2c-f6e5-43c2-9b54-18660a9bfd41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Even if you spent decades building a six-figure 401(k) or IRA... What good is that number, when the cost of living may give your retirement fund a 5-6 year expiration date?
It doesn't take a catastrophic event like a market collapse for you to lose everything. All it may take is a retirement account full of paper assets... while the cost of living keeps climbing.
You worked too hard building your nest egg for it to fail you at the finish line. But there is still time to protect your life savings from losing its buying power. The IRS allows you to roll over the balance from a 401(k)/IRA into a historically secure option for preserving its value.

_**(Piece continues below)**_
President Trump was never supposed to survive politically. According to the experts, the media, the consultants, and the establishment class, his movement should have collapsed years ago. Instead, the opposite happened. The movement hardened. Expanded. Became more loyal. More populist. More battle tested.
And Tuesday night showed it again.
Texas voters did not simply hand President Trump another endorsement victory. They delivered a political reckoning.
Ken Paxton's massive runoff victory over John Cornyn was not simply the defeat of a longtime senator. It was the public rejection of the old Bush-Rove Republican machine that dominated Texas politics for decades. The donor class lost. The consultant class lost. The carefully managed establishment wing of the Republican Party lost.
The message from Texas Republicans was unmistakable: the era of weak, cautious, consultant-approved Republicanism is over.
Then came another powerful signal.

Mayes Middleton's victory over Chip Roy in the Attorney General runoff showed Republican voters are no longer looking for polished policy Republicans who know how to perform conservatism on cable news.
Ken Paxton transformed the Texas Attorney General's office into one of the most aggressive conservative legal weapons in America, and Texas Republicans made it clear Tuesday night they want that fight to continue. They are no longer rewarding caution. They are rewarding confrontation, aggression, and political fearlessness.
Even the Railroad Commissioner race carried the same anti-establishment energy as grassroots conservatives rallied behind Bo French against the full weight of the Texas Republican establishment backing Jim Wright, including support tied to Governor Abbott and Lieutenant Governor Dan Patrick.
Across the board, Republican voters sent the same message repeatedly:
Fight.
Then came Vegas.
The Golden Knights did not just beat Colorado. They suffocated them. The Avalanche entered the series with enormous expectations after finishing with the league's best regular season record. Vegas responded by sweeping them out of the playoffs and outscoring them 14-7 across the series.
That is not survival.
That is dominance.
Jack Eichel has been phenomenal. Mark Stone returned and immediately made his presence felt. Carter Hart locked things down in goal. Coach John Tortorella has transformed this team into a relentless defensive machine that looks increasingly dangerous with every round.
And maybe that is the larger theme of the night.
Americans are exhausted by weakness.
They are exhausted by institutions that lecture endlessly but fail constantly. They are drawn instead toward strength, clarity, results, and confidence. Whether in sports or politics, people respond to leadership that fights, executes, and refuses to apologize for wanting to win.
That is what the Golden Knights embody.

| Just recently, I sent a letter to the Trump administration demanding immediate action to lower energy costs for working families.

Gas prices have soared more than 30% this year. The national average is now over $4 a gallon, which is up more than a dollar since February. That's the biggest jump in six decades.

And it's not just gas. Electricity prices are rising faster than inflation. More than 80 million Americans are struggling to pay their utility bills. Families here in West Michigan are making impossible choices between groceries, rent, and keeping the lights on.

This is an affordability crisis. And Washington Republicans have made it worse at every turn.

That's why I co-founded the Lowering Costs Caucus, because someone has to fight for families when prices are out of control. I'm not going to sit on the sidelines while West Michigan families get squeezed.

body:
By 2030, Texas will carry even more weight in the House and in the Electoral College.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
The stakes of this race are high, Peter.
Last month, Republicans got the Supreme Court decision they wanted, weakening key protections that helped communities of color fight back against rigged maps.
And Greg Abbott made it clear he’ll keep using _every_ lever of power to redraw lines to lock in Republican seats and bend the playing field before people start voting.
We need you to know what that means for the future and why it’s important to get involved in this race, but first, [**will you make a $5 donation to Gina’s campaign to make sure she’s elected in November and end corruption in Texas?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260527_2_stakes.uYgVnq&refcode=em20260527-1205&amount=5&t=1&akid=1205%2E299639%2EWD0ae8)
Texas is growing fast. After the next census, we’re projected to gain 4-5 more congressional seats.
Those seats will come from blue states like California and New York because Texas is growing at a quicker pace. Which means Texas will carry _even more weight_ in the House and in the Electoral College.
If Republicans control Texas through the end of the decade, they will be able to draw maps so extreme that it will become harder and harder for Democrats to win Congress, and even more difficult to win the White House.
**But right now there’s one thing Abbott can’t gerrymander — this governor’s race.**
That’s why this election is a national turning point. **If Texans elect a governor who will veto rigged maps, we can stop the next Republican gerrymandering stunt before it happens and protect a fair playing field for the rest of the country.**
Right now, we have an end-of-month goal of raising **$100,000 by Sunday** so we can stay on offense, organize statewide, and build the campaign it will take to beat Abbott.

Thank you,

body:
From the rear steps of Lincoln’s memorial you can look directly across the Arlington Memorial Bridge to the graves of hundreds of thousands of men and women who fought and died so our democracy would survive.
#
Peter, take a look at this.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260527-1-60&refcode2=35175.3013755.Q2EHUb&akid=35175%2E3013755%2EQ2EHUb)
That’s a mockup of the “triumphal” arch Trump wants to build in front of Arlington National Cemetery.
If you’ve ever been to Washington, you know our monuments and sacred spaces have been plotted and built over generations by thoughtful stewards of America’s heritage and history. One of the most poignant examples of that is the space between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260527-1-60&refcode2=35175.3013755.Q2EHUb&akid=35175%2E3013755%2EQ2EHUb)
From the rear steps of Lincoln’s memorial you can look directly across the Arlington Memorial Bridge to the graves of hundreds of thousands of men and women who fought and died so our democracy would survive. Donald Trump wants to block that view with a 250-foot-tall arch. A golden monument to himself. The Arc de Trump.
Just one more insult from the man who trampled the graves of the fallen at Arlington for a campaign photo op. The same man who called the fallen “suckers” and “losers,” and refused to honor them because of a little rain. **Trump dodged the draft five times, and now he wants to force our honored dead into his shadow.**
This has gone on long enough, and we must put an end to it.
[**Peter, we’re writing to ask you to voice your opposition. Veterans are already suing to block this arch, and we need to build a loud, nationwide opposition to support them. Add your name here and say no to the Arc de Trump.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/2600506_ARC_DE_TRUMP/?source=em260527-1-60&refcode2=35175.3013755.Q2EHUb&akid=35175%2E3013755%2EQ2EHUb)

name: Martin Sheen
subject: Take it from a former (fictional) President…

body:
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/972?t=1001&akid=52%2E245147%2EER1Xxd ][IMG]

Derek, this is
Martin Sheen.

You may know me best as an actor, portraying President Jed Bartlet in The
West Wing for seven years, or as an activist. But today, I wanted to reach
out just as a fellow American, who — like you — is gravely concerned with
the direction our country is headed.

I’ve walked with Josh Shapiro, I’ve campaigned with him, and I’ve watched
him for a long time, so I can say with all the confidence in the world:
There is no greater friend to our democracy and our Constitution than
Governor Shapiro.

Josh has spent his entire life standing up to bullies like Donald Trump.
He defeated Trump’s election lies in court dozens of times. He took on big
corporations to protect health care access for thousands.
And Derek, he’s
never forgotten about the future of our country either — leading the
charge to secure record funding for public education in Pennsylvania.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/972?t=1002&akid=52%2E245147%2EER1Xxd ]But Derek,
you and I both know: Pennsylvania is a swing state like no other. So Josh
Shapiro is counting on you, me, and everyone to offer what they can.
Please, will you join me in support of Governor Shapiro and chip in
whatever sounds right to you toward his campaign for reelection?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/973?t=1003&akid=52%2E245147%2EER1Xxd ]Donate $5 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/972?t=1008&akid=52%2E245147%2EER1Xxd ]Other →

And so, take it from the former “acting” President:

Competitive campaigns like this one are only won when thousands, even
millions of ordinary Americans like yourself step up and take action.

That’s what we’ll need to win in Pennsylvania.

Thank you,

Martin Sheen

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with supporters like you.

He said, _“In three weeks, I treated more children than I have in all other warzones, combined... What I witnessed was a genocide, paid for with American tax dollars and propped up by our foreign policy.”_ Like Dr. Hamawy, **Saikat Chakrabarti** is a champion of the people who’s demanding an end to genocide, wars, poverty, and ICE. If elected, he’ll join me in the fight to ban stock trading for members of Congress. subject: REPORT: Oregon election officials discuss Trump attacks on voting and what's at stake
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
The Trump administration is escalating its attacks on free and fair elections. But Oregon is fighting back. Here’s how:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
Recently, the Department of Justice sued me for refusing to hand over sensitive voter information, including driver’s license numbers, Social Security numbers, and birthdays.
I said no.
And I’ll keep saying no. Because protecting the integrity of our elections also means protecting the privacy and rights of Oregon voters.
The truth is, Oregon’s elections are secure . Our vote-by-mail system works . Our county clerks work tirelessly to ensure every eligible voter can cast a ballot safely and securely.
But instead of strengthening democracy, President Donald Trump and his allies are trying to undermine confidence in elections and make it harder for Americans to vote.
I believe Oregon has a responsibility to stand firm when the federal government overreaches or demands unconstitutional access to private voter data.
That fight is ongoing.
So I’m asking: will you chip in today to help me continue defending voting rights, election integrity, and the rule of law here in Oregon? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
The so-called SAVE Act is a perfect example. It’s being sold as “election security,” but in reality, it would make voting harder for millions of eligible Americans — including rural voters, seniors, students, tribal communities, and married women whose names may not match old documents.
That’s not protecting democracy. That’s restricting it.
And I believe we should make it easier for eligible citizens to vote — not harder.
At moments like this, steady leadership matters.
We don’t need panic or political theater. We need people willing to stand up, tell the truth, and protect our democracy even when it’s difficult.
That’s exactly what I intend to keep doing. If you’re with me, please make a donation today – any amount makes a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]

| | Fellow Patriot,
With May coming to a close, summer is officially here - and with it a make-or-break moment for our campaign.

name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: Help Free Two Innocent Officers Before It's Too Late
body:
Patriot,
This is a disgrace...and every American who believes in law and order should be furious.
Two police officers—Josh Taylor and Brandon Dingman—are currently serving prison sentences for doing exactly what they were trained and ordered to do: respond to a dangerous call, use non-lethal force, and protecting their community.
Let me tell you what really happened, because the media and the District Attorney certainly won't.
On the night of July 4th, 2019, Officer Josh Taylor responded to a domestic disturbance call in Wilson, Oklahoma. When he arrived, he encountered Jared Lakey: a large, fully grown man walking naked down the street wearing nothing but socks.
Josh immediately recognized this situation for what it was: dangerous and unpredictable. Whether it was drugs, mental illness, or something else—this wasn't a man in his right mind. And Josh knew he couldn't handle it alone. He called for backup.
[Donate to Their Defense](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=2e14bc13c9ca46d7b306ba2828909608&_e=x0V3egNx0u8-aci6y-j21hpZsRsIZoc1XyFGYJM8q5zDRYt3R1GV4-1_VdyXo7KLSZa8UkHjIyCtLZMQ68iYsyc_fZyN_gF2Ad8nBe_B9SYfzTaHqDwmo9Pwy7R4hi34WzNXgn0W2NZTH3qJ7XAzDZvBmLASUQuTqeU2mXud-44r6ylgA-qBWValgCyzYiIGxagPsrIcs3paRn4GLKqQk8pS0VNpii3RhwI2fZvrmoHA7BjW7TDdxIEi8biRCZRw3IAIVV_7snBvSj8fiBf7oAASr2jbGYIuYD4st0wH9TE9zq12ca-jzJq9W_je3L-wqDH8ynxP0wnzt7CuuaBzWE06_vgg6IGrDGK65gEq7eW3MSJCXPrJ1jgv07tT7cKnoMKUvER8Y7clNYDGqqjAGDlWA7-VY_ZkU8qyOD9PltF8R3mAB31DPm8_SY3WM3Th)
Officer Josh Taylor
Officer Brandon Dingman
Officer Brandon Dingman arrived on scene, and the two officers tried to do what they were trained to do: safely and professionally bring Mr. Lakey into custody.
But Lakey was 350 pounds, combative, and resisting arrest. When verbal commands didn't work and physical restraint proved impossible, they turned to their department-issued, non-lethal tasers.
They deployed them multiple times, but Lakey kept tearing the barbs out. He was clearly not being fully affected by the tasers—and even after repeated attempts, the officers were unable to subdue him.
Eventually, Josh and Brandon were able to get his arms and cuffed him. They immediately called for medical assistance. An ambulance arrived. Lakey was taken to the hospital.
At that point, the officers had done everything they could—and everything right.
But tragically, Jared Lakey passed away two days later. The autopsy was inconclusive. He had an enlarged heart and lung issues. Drug screenings were unreliable due to the fluids pumped into his system at the hospital. There was no determined cause of death.
Even so, the department launched an internal review. Then the City Council reviewed the case too.
Both cleared the officers. That's two separate investigations concluding Josh and Brandon followed procedure.
Case closed, right?
Wrong.
A full year later, a politically motivated District Attorney, smelling an opportunity, dragged the case back up and charged these officers with second-degree murder.
Let that sink in: second-degree murder. He ignored the internal findings. He ignored the medical uncertainty. He ignored the fact that these officers never even laid a hand on Lakey's neck or airway.
They followed their training, used the gear they were issued, and even called for medical help.
But none of that mattered to a DA looking to make headlines.
Now, these two good cops, family men, community protectors, are sitting behind bars.
The National Center for Police Defense is fighting to overturn this injustice. We're supporting their legal appeals, helping their families, and backing efforts to remove the biased District Attorney who never should have touched this case in the first place.
But appeals are costly. And the longer this drags on, the longer Josh and Brandon sit in prison...separated from their families, their children, their lives.
That's why I'm writing you today. We need your help.
[Yes — I'll Donate Today](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=2e14bc13c9ca46d7b306ba2828909608&_e=x0V3egNx0u8-aci6y-j21hpZsRsIZoc1XyFGYJM8q5zDRYt3R1GV4-1_VdyXo7KLSZa8UkHjIyCtLZMQ68iYsyc_fZyN_gF2Ad8nBe_B9Sbc96NqY2BUpkrHG7SEY7uBYZy0s1V5VYRmbIf0_lNtzITuSugP_0Tv24qUNZcwLLHvOKee7UtMMeelnmx3469AFGxaDdOA81vhSGAjtJ8I2XIW53ieZCEVRG9ylNF5HQrcSG4T36uz_e2PI27vb2lfC7Zi66RnWFsdKH0VDGtJxRb7U0PcDRyB3rMltrjuFEu2bhUo11kVhtNQsbIK_GBSnr1hdY-1ORZExPgKiXzCSuNiKgBctXuD4nVYuxP0Dg1EdgamZ1OWYNBWZnPRNQEK9Iha4n2x9JFks6vcEkIVOOyRbWEcjeZpu19bDei4ssN_8HClGeOlhWjM5KXjWsGv)
We need to raise funds to fuel the legal defense and appeal process. These officers deserve their freedom. They deserve a fair hearing. And they deserve to come home.
We cannot let this go unanswered. If we don't stand up now, more and more police officers will suffer the same fate: thrown to the wolves by political activists in prosecutor's clothing.
Josh and Brandon were railroaded, plain and simple. And now we need to right this wrong.
Will you step up today and donate to support their appeals?
## Stand With Josh & Brandon
Every dollar goes directly to their legal defense and appeals. Help bring them home.
[Click Here to Donate](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=2e14bc13c9ca46d7b306ba2828909608&_e=x0V3egNx0u8-aci6y-j21hpZsRsIZoc1XyFGYJM8q5zDRYt3R1GV4-1_VdyXo7KLSZa8UkHjIyCtLZMQ68iYsyc_fZyN_gF2Ad8nBe_B9SYLx-nrnKDjURKhRNMM5q0GQgitFiwxeJ1OZPnBEOw8a35npOxKRO6XMN5srl9OSJ1D_5KKsJv23O-6_HnWUfh0P3bi4Pll3d0jP42Mbgl80UW3ii3dOu3NcjneCEr01XP6UBpjL0LH73qr-oaiYtslKcufUdn3qfhmdc-prVPlK0Y5vOlqXYks7_eYLMLV24XnTEUZ3qOTpVHD88VNk_7KF7rykDXkrHMbfqQ39f-aj0Ai0yV0N_wlyZoPOYE8y5WALYUDx-nQEcyvdR7Kha7Nh2l30ITnQTWF0w5AY1votwCW3ZEKvonxEuMZOFPKagErmmPJbcBYeFyxSTXrD9Ym)
Your generous gift goes to defending these officers and restoring justice. No family should have to go through this. No officer should be imprisoned for doing his job.
Let's send a message: we still back the badge—and we won't let politics destroy the lives of our heroes.
For justice,
Sheriff Joe Arpaio (ret.)
National Center for Police Defense | Defenders for Justice

clean_body: Grassroots donations are slowing. Republican fundraising is not. But this isn't over. | = Hi Peter, I want to be honest with you about where we stand. Our grassroots donations have slowed down at exactly the wrong time. At a moment when Republicans are raising aggressively to hold onto power, fewer small-dollar donors are coming through the door for Democratic pro-choice women. I understand why. Donor fatigue is real. Life is expensive — now more than ever. People are overwhelmed. But here's the part that keeps me up at night: Republicans are not slowing down. They’re fundraising at a furious pace — powered by fear, misinformation, and manufactured outrage. And right now, it's working. **“Put $50 million into New Hampshire, and you pick up a seat.”**
Team,
That’s exactly how national Republicans are viewing New Hampshire’s Senate race right now.
**And make no mistake: A massive wave of GOP money is headed our way.**
Outside groups are already setting up operations on the ground because they know New Hampshire could decide the Senate majority. In fact one Republican strategist predicted total spending here could reach $400 million by Election Day.
**I’ve said before that this is the toughest race I’ve ever run, and I mean it.** National Republicans see the Granite State as one of their absolute best pickup opportunities in the country, and they are ready to spend whatever it takes to flip this seat.
The only way we win is by building a people-powered grassroots campaign capable of weathering any storm. And with our end-of-month fundraising deadline fast approaching, we need all hands on deck right now.

body:

Friend,

I have always believed that if you don’t show up, you don’t get to lead.

For decades, uncontested races across Maryland meant that extremist rhetoric went unchallenged, leaving neighbors with a space on their ballot and no voice in their government.

No community in our state is a lost cause. That is why I am so energized by what is happening right now.

For the first time since 1974, Maryland Democrats have a candidate in every single race up and down the ballot, all across the state. This historic recruitment is the essential first step in flipping the map from red to blue. We are no longer conceding any community to extremist rhetoric.

If you are ready to prioritize the needs of Maryland families over partisan theatrics, I need you to join this fight today. Your donation of $15 ensures we have the resources to show up, compete, and win where it really counts. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/SEMD-03-Email-May2026-FR-DownBallot?&refcode=E29809-20260527-DownWins-SL-CampaignNews&amount=15]

The opportunity to break the cycle of gridlock is within reach, but it starts with ensuring no community is left behind.

Thank you for partnering with me.

Onward,

Sarah Elfreth

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. I’ve said this from the start, which is why I’m extremely proud to have earned End Citizens United’s endorsement. I’m also proud to have led the Democratic primary in calling for an end to Congressional stock trading – and my campaign has refused to take corporate PAC money. Asking for money doesn’t come naturally to me. But I have to, if we’re going to flip MI-07 and take back the House. body:

#
# **Celebrating More Affordable Housing in Overbrook!**
Senator Hughes was [thrilled to celebrate the opening of Good Shepard Senior](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171836.172806.209&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17538) affordable housing this month. [Senator Hughes supported the development of this project](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171836.172806.209&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17539) alongside a tremendous group of city, state, business, and community leaders. It took ten years, but now the community has 55 new affordable housing units for seniors. The housing development was built on the site where the [Overbrook Presbyterian Church burned down](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171836.172806.209&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17540). Faith leaders and developers connected and decided to use the land to provide affordable housing to the community- a living tribute to what the church and the congregations that celebrated there represent. Developers of the Good Shepard Housing project successfully secured [state funding](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171836.172806.209&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17541) even though there was serious competition for limited resources. This project is a critical step forward in the fight for more affordable housing, but we must continue fighting for more. The [PA Department of Community and Economic Development](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171836.172806.209&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17542) estimates the Commonwealth must add 450,000 new housing units by 2035 to meet projected demand. With affordable housing funding already oversubscribed, it has become increasingly competitive to secure these resources. To tackle this, [Governor Shapiro's Housing Action Plan](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171836.172806.209&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17543) is working to streamline funding and expand capacity. The opening of Good Shepard is a great example of what can be acheived when we listen to the people we represent and deliver on **affordability**. Senator Hughes is working hard with leaders across the city and state to make more of this good work happen. **[Learn more about the 55 new units online!](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171836.172806.209&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17544)**

It’s up to us to break Greg Abbott’s gerrymander this November and show that South Texas will fight back against anyone who wants to rig our maps and steal our democracy. I’m an old-school Democrat fighting to give working families a voice in our government — for people like my mom, fellow deputies on patrol, and their children too. Turning Texas blue and making Republicans pay

In just a moment I am going to ask you to split a contribution between the Texas Democratic Party and Gina Hinajosa's campaign to become the next governor of that state.
Here's the truth:
Last night, Ken Paxton won the Republican primary for United States Senate. He'll be taking on James Talarico who has a chance to win this race -- in part because of the great success he has had with small-dollar fundraising.
If you haven't yet, you should contribute to James Talarico.
But the Texas Democratic Party and Gina Hinojosa desperately need our support as well. There is a chance they are getting overlooked in all of the Ken Paxton news and that would be a real shame.
James will turn out voters that help Gina Hinojosa win. But the inverse is true as well -- Gina's success will be great for James turning out Democrats he can't reach.
And a Texas Democratic Party with significant resources is good for both of them ... and all the Democratic candidates who have a chance to flip seats because of the Republican map-rigging scheme in the state. **We can make Republicans pay!**

Not many people can say they lived the worst day of their life on national television.
I can.
It isn't easy to relive January 6th over and over again. But I consider it my duty to NEVER let anyone forget that our democracy almost died that day.
That's why I testified about my experience before Congress despite constant death threats and racist hate.
It's why I am suing Donald Trump to block his Thug Fund that would REWARD the rioters that beat my fellow Capitol Police Officers and me bloody.
**And it 's why I'm running for Congress in Maryland's 5th District to END his Washington trifecta and hold him accountable.**
Now, I'm less than one month away from my competitive primary. Dark money groups are flooding this district with $3.75 MILLION to boost my opponents. Shady outside groups and corporate donors want to maintain the status quo, but we can't afford to let that happen. We need Democrats who will fight back against Trump's attacks on our democracy at every turn.
#### **[That's why I am personally asking for your support TODAY to overcome this wall of dark money, win this primary, and flip the House. We need just 5 supporters from your area to give before midnight. Can you send a grassroots donation of any amount today?](https://substack.com/redirect/53f2c9d6-dceb-40ca-a5b1-55c1759a9f2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[PITCH IN](https://substack.com/redirect/53f2c9d6-dceb-40ca-a5b1-55c1759a9f2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Make no mistake: This "slush fund" is really Trump putting his personal militia on retainer.
On January 6th, after the rioters beat us, crushed us, and hurled racial slurs, they repeated one thing over and over:
"The president said we could."
That wasn't an exaggeration. That wasn't media spin. That's what they told us.
Then, Trump PARDONED them and set up a fund to cut them big checks. He's not just excusing the deadly insurrection -- he wants to PAY his mob to commit violence on his behalf.
This is a disgusting attack on our democracy and on your taxpayer dollars. I'm ready to win this race and STOP Trump from destroying our democracy permanently. But I need YOUR help to get to Congress.
#### **[Please pitch in any amount you can to help me win this competitive primary, flip the House, and end Trump's trifecta.](https://substack.com/redirect/53f2c9d6-dceb-40ca-a5b1-55c1759a9f2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Harry Dunn

body:
Trump won't rush an Iran nuclear deal as the two sides' 14-point framework leaks.

|
---
|
---
Sponsored By:
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0MFq7CAYBeCnMbsJ-htjXLi43CGLwpQpHSh0E4z-mUg1CUab1y_pI3R34By-xfm4DTfjg1-eryaiTnka3OoGRXMqcTv8YnKecS9bwoh2LQNQaC9UXEAOSxhY5bSzzjBboWZSKgWCd7Ka9YQwKipF11DZApcKJ6TWCTGBlcp1ldcnRQVI4A2nsm7ZiE60THQKwfGGNNQETLlOuJUxeGuWbPavaU0Wa7vGKug5520n_B-BnkB_HEf9LBe0azx7Aj1cm3vbqfczPt5ePjk7l7zfy8gIvz7u_6uk3Xb4EPzeStLQZzQ-_Or5D2d8a_gJAAD__zASaoM)
The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with
Republican Task Force Issue: 5/27/2026
Iran Deal at Crunch Point

Iran's state television released a [14-point draft memorandum of understanding](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D-PnDAQBfBPYzqvYAx4KVykobu0KdHgGRbrjG35z6Hk00ebJv2170lPT79fH9sHOu_C6ydebHI9Noq0LX3N7Uq3C1jryaWlzBfb2DboYZb9JEFvwW9DR4Ys4WA7NoPWywKTeuruNPsOiz54Iqto19pOz4UGUgR2BgI1ds68p_oJNKhR9foxDzvTNA_Tc2EgNYqxR8-5PjKntntnMVQsn0fMlh82Xp03Z62pCPVDwCpgve_7kblVzuXdv5OYPQlYL0fkWTKWKmB1GYMs-LtIynhU2YokRi_v2DzJzDFxkGfMV_sjy-lScuElOZAM-IVe7j7aTySW_ykErF02lG7nvSuzFmP_utD5fzfrN1S_DPwNAAD__8xqiDw) showing that any agreement with the U.S. would reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the American naval blockade — the most substantive disclosure yet from negotiations that have lurched forward in fits and starts. Trump convened his Cabinet at the White House on Wednesday — a previously planned Camp David session was scrapped — and told reporters he is not yet "satisfied" with the terms. [The president said Iran is "negotiating on fumes"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O6yAUhJ_G7ojg8GcKituky223tI7hkKDF2MJ48_or5xG2HI00mu_7eswPzCXX539cybee5rjF2fHeznV_54q9v-g490Yrhe2cgYNhXDOwcy2zGKOPIaIII3lhrXOg5WTHl5eAJjkpyaFZuJAEyUonME3RGBtgzP6a4hosSCW5vRmxUNRG6MkRRKkGxbFQ67dG-7mUHLB2PL7T1gLdwraOxb96349B_hvgPsAd90rv46qu0HoOhQa4f0hYblhZPUMhbCzgkit1thL1XJ8Mk7VRT2KycklEQUK0UsGizaQEKDU2H_d3LiUfxg6KP1fM5fOh_0HZj4ffAAAA__9Znnlu) and dismissed political pressure to close a deal before November: "I don't care about the midterms." The emerging framework defers many critical disputes for later resolution, and critics within Trump's own coalition warn that Iran's leadership could emerge from the conflict battered but emboldened. [Trump has said](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2unTAUhFdjOl-ZA8bXhYs0dC9tSnTAB7Cef5BtYt2sPiJLSDnSaObT9-tr-ULnXTx-YiCT677YZBctar7D1VzEWk8q95Up0JbuBQRMXEgOaol-6Ttr7Gax3zoyvVJagxzeqjuNRFrVKieS47tfNWqSegcrViGANk2dM8-UkKBgGAehXlO_kpVTL9-awA4jGwV6yvWV6bpX7zaMFcv3nvJGry2Fzpuz1quw4QeDmcHcWns1LKeLR02xukDl6TGYI7XCYH4OGcwBP09QDGaXMfKCn8IvitbFg-8ZA7WUv7kl9PwuvKXbW54pXRR5qRld5WfK4f7DYO6ysVdz3rsyKTaKI6Dz_-jqf8j8beBvAAAA__-vcYV1) he needs terms that credibly diminish Iran's nuclear capability before he can declare victory and wind down a conflict that has weighed on Republican standing ahead of the midterms. ★★★
Senate Moves to Oust Parliamentarian

Support is growing within Senate Republican ranks to remove Parliamentarian Elizabeth MacDonough after she ruled that $1 billion in funding for the White House ballroom project violated the Byrd Rule and had to be stripped from the budget reconciliation bill. [The Hill reports](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LGO5CAQBNCvwZlH0MbGBASXOJtLL7R6oD1GB9iC9s7vr2Y32HzTKumVVP_u6x1jiuX5FzO5ytsajrBayfXK5ysWZN6pXWelTP64VpAw9XLswawlraoLLviAynfklDHWwjjMptudpslYrZU0yusZaRqUBzNoqdRDK7110b0pOYKBQQ_S3Cb1oDBOapwtQRi00BITVb5VOq9Hih4LY_u_HdXTzR-5S25nPpsY_ghYBCy80x5TencClv3IVOjVBCyNCjIJWMbZTmBl_x30P3Drt3o1rsjxKP2JNUXMVBhrxCJg6aoL5yumFNtkhJbPjPFrqONffPbh4DMAAP__vkJ7mA) the coalition backing her removal has expanded significantly in recent days. "The fire-the-parliamentarian group is growing — there are quite a few members now," [one Senate Republican aide told reporters](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGunTAQRL8GOpC9GAyFizR0N21KtNjrixWDkb1clL-PeM3r31QjjXRGOn9eywtDDMf7N-5kMvvFJbdMgvO1n3c4kHmjcp2ZdrLpWkDA0Ii-Ab0ccZG1M846lLYmI7WeJui7UdebGfwEg5rk6JUSzo-rVn5YJdh-ROy0rIN5UKIHDZ3qhG4HuZLrB9mPE4HrVKUERsrcZjqvNQaLB2P561O21Nq019FszGepul8VzBXM9323_3BL6VkrmA-6SwUzZg420lMLHcjUfANLsyJzpCZ9KDf-4itTI8UTEF278R7rbNx5hxhDGXSlxHvHEL_--Qe6Pgb-BwAA___yXHnE), adding that sentiment is particularly strong among newer MAGA-aligned members. MacDonough's rulings have also blocked the SAVE America Act — a voter ID and citizenship verification bill — from advancing through reconciliation. Senate Majority Leader John Thune has resisted calls to act, arguing that protecting the parliamentarian as an institutional guardrail benefits Republicans when Democrats next control the chamber. [Conservative critics counter](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJycULuymzAQ_RrRySMWA6agSEN306ZkFu1iNNGDkVZhnK_P2PmD2545719f6xc67-LzJwaes-wrJVonI7mG83IRRQ4u9cwc2Ka6goFBm17DuEa_tg3NZAlb2_DcjuM0Qd89xuaYYaCBDLXEiLyP-_4wNPUTtVNPD9qnxs1vK9PDCN29M-NtaDemfmj7x8RA3V3dDXrOcst81s07i1Gw_N5TtnyzKTR-PkTOorofChYFCwbOb5Z3G2d53SJfRcFiUwgcBfNLwSIH6ysFjHrjw0XSb8DWLOiivo6XLhxRWJ-YvcP_OodRs3d_cWM5dEBLKab6PHSoRfQzfaJrYQXLe5KCxfQKlibPdF7Oe1eGUd3NM6Dzn-LyjZ__zPAvAAD__zk7kFs) that MacDonough's rulings represent a structural roadblock to the Republican agenda — and that the Big Beautiful Bill cannot pass intact with her in place. ★★★
Court Rules 9-0 for Trump

The Supreme Court handed the Trump administration a unanimous victory, ruling in its favor in a dispute over whether the Justice Department can restrict immigration judges' work-related public speech. [All nine justices](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2ynSAQx58GO87gKqAFRRq7mzalw2FXJRfFgfX6-hnPI6TaX7Hz__rzNX_5mOKx_vY7ucLLjBnnUXG59vOOh2feqF5noZ1CvmZQYKTSEux8pLlt0GFA34aGXGvtOILuBttszgy0jEYPS7t0vUUNIxlcFBhUagzom-geKaXBQtd3yr5M-ybUptXDSIBdL3rlExV-FTqvd4rBH-zr95JLoFfIe5PcxnxW0f0SMAmYeKOFkIpPsfLzIWB6PARMSj_80KeXrCEXqs_hq8o7HjIe8u2ZE8n8Q0XGfY9r8RzzIf9euFKVdy7fslDyTCjrSRQ2AVNTHJ53TClWY0Wv1t3H9InH_7Hmj4N_AQAA__93IYUn) — including the three liberals — sided with the government and reversed lower court rulings. The case centered on Justice Department policies barring immigration judges from making public statements about their official duties that could conflict with administration enforcement priorities. body:
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4810%2E898137%2EhqqQhA)
Hi there,
Lately, I’ve been hearing from more and more parents who are expressing a really deep, relatable frustration: They feel like they have effectively lost their kids to their phones.
It is honestly not the fault of the kids. A lot of the phone apps they’re obsessed with are intentionally designed by tech companies to keep young people glued to the screen as hard as possible.
I know tech advancements can be great — don’t get me wrong — but we have to protect our kids in the digital world the exact same way we protect them in the real world. We don’t let them smoke, drink, or just do whatever they want without rules, and the internet shouldn't be a wild west either.
That is why I’ve put forward a comprehensive plan for kids’ online safety and privacy.
* Banning cell phones in the classroom so kids can actually focus and talk to each other.
* Requiring social media platforms to have "privacy by default" settings for minors.
* Cutting off features like "infinite scroll" and push notification limits for anyone under 14.
* Stopping chatbots from acting like licensed pros.
* Expanding the Children’s Online Privacy Act (COPPA) to give families real data protection.

The current administration tries to argue that we can’t put regulations in place because it hurts tech advancement. But you and I both know that’s simply not true. We protect people in every other industry — **it’s time big tech plays by the same rules.**
We already rolled out a plan to protect families from online scams, but we need to finish the job and keep our kids safe, too.
[**If you’re with me on this, will you sign on to show your support for this plan right now?**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/signup/MAM-202605-OnlineSafety-email/?&t=2&akid=4810%2E898137%2EhqqQhA)

Hi friend,
We’re heading into the final stretch before primary ballots go out, and this is one of the most important moments of the campaign so far.
This month, our By the People Tour made incredible stops in Dolores, Pagosa Springs, Ridgway, Grand Junction, Durango, Carbondale, Pueblo West, and Telluride. We sat down with community members to talk about the issues that matter most to their communities: affordable housing, protecting our public lands, lowering costs, and upholding the rule of law.
That’s how we’re building this campaign. By showing up, listening, and focusing on what it takes to deliver real results for Colorado’s 3rd. But we really need to keep that momentum going.
Before the end of the month, we need to raise $3,500 to stay on track as we head toward the June 30 primary. Every dollar helps us stay on the road, reach more voters, and keep building this people-powered campaign the right way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-ak?&]
Together, we can finish this month strong.
Will you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us reach our goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-ak?&]
CHIP IN » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-ak?]
The next few weeks will shape this race. Let’s make them count.
